data.title: Senior Technical Program Manager I
data.description: Join Axon and be a Force for Good. At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands OR Germany - Remote Travel: up to 40% within DACH, Benelux, Nordics (an other European countries as needed) Reports to: Director, Professional Services, EMEA Your Impact As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you’ll lead high-visibility projects, directly contributing to the development and implementation of solutions that truly make a difference. In this role, you’ll tackle complex challenges, working with some of the most advanced technologies in the industry, including cloud and on-prem platforms, and mission-critical systems. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds across professional services, sales, engineering, product, and customer teams to deliver solutions that save lives and enhance public trust. At Axon, we’re driven by a powerful mission: to protect life, capture truth, and accelerate justice. We’re growing rapidly, and this is your chance to make a lasting impact at a company where innovation meets purpose. What You’ll Do Program & Project Management Manage all aspects of complex enterprise-grade product deployments Oversee project milestones, resource planning, scope, timeline, and risk management. Manage cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and on-time delivery. Ensures project milestones and deadlines are met and associated documentation supports customer acceptance for purposes of revenue recognition Support pre-sales scoping and post-sales implementation handoff. Operates with a sense of urgency, accuracy, and detail-orientation, while maintaining consistent lines of communication with all teams involved in each project Maintain customer confidence, especially in high-pressure situations Remain organized and focused on removing obstacles through creativity and adaptation to rapidly changing circumstances Partner Management Own the relationship with 3rd party integrator and the client throughout the length of the contract Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with Professional Services, Product Managers, and Engineers to align program execution with business goals. Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams to manage change requests, solution feasibility, and roadmap alignment. Process Improvement Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to increase deployment speed, quality, and customer satisfaction. Contribute to internal SOPs, implementation playbooks, and best practices. What You Bring Fluency in both German and English European citizenship is required in order to work with sensitive Government data, willing to undergo a security check 5+ years of experience leading and delivering highly complex programs, with demonstrated success in technical program management. Proven track record of managing enterprise-level software deployments, infrastructure projects, or large-scale enterprise application programs. Deep expertise in delivering complex projects involving cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and product. Mastery of program/project management tools and methodologies to track, report, and deliver on objectives. (PMP, PRINCE2, SCRUM) Experience gathering requirements, optimizing workflows, and facilitating change management within teams. Familiarity with software configurations and coding experience (particularly JSON) preferred. Advanced communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill technical concepts for diverse audiences. Proficiency in guiding client and internal teams through ambiguity, driving alignment, and executing on shared goals. Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Important Notes The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions. Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment. We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at Axon Privacy Web Form . For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment. We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. data.title: GTM Manager
data.description: tl;dr After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry 6 of the 20 largest construction companies in the German-speaking region already rely on Kuro every day, representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build About us Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling. Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction. One year after launch, Kuro runs every day inside the back offices of DACH’s largest construction companies, which together build more than €40 billion a year. We automate their core workflows and help them make faster, better decisions. We’re just getting started. The construction software companies that reached billion-dollar scale did it by owning core back-office workflows, and that’s where we already are. With AI, we believe the next category leader can be 10x bigger. We raised a €10M seed round to build it. We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind. Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin The Opportunity As GTM Manager, you'll play a key role in driving Kuro's commercial growth by generating new business opportunities, engaging prospective customers, and turning go-to-market initiatives into results. You'll be hands-on across the customer journey, from prospecting and building relationships to supporting POCs and transforming them into long-term customer relationships. You'll work directly with our Founding GTM Manager to bring our go-to-market strategy to life, while collaborating closely with our Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. Together, you'll strengthen our commercial activities, improve how we engage and convert customers, and help scale Kuro's go-to-market engine as the company grows. What You'll Do Drive top-of-funnel activities through prospecting, targeted outreach, lead qualification, and relationship building. Manage and develop customer opportunities from first contact through product demonstrations, POCs, and commercial discussions. Create compelling customer presentations, proposals, and business cases to support commercial conversations. Maintain and improve CRM, pipeline reporting, and sales processes, including identifying opportunities for automation. Work closely with the Founding GTM Manager to execute commercial initiatives, coordinate customer-facing activities, and share relevant market and product feedback. Your Profile 2–4 years of experience in business development, sales, account management, or a similar customer-facing GTM role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. Proven hands-on experience in prospecting, outbound sales, pipeline generation, and managing customer relationships. Strong commercial mindset and communication skills, with the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders. Technical curiosity and an analytical, structured approach to solving problems and identifying opportunities. Proactive, highly driven, and execution-oriented, with strong organizational skills and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced startup environment. Fluent in German and English (more languages are a plus). Why Kuro You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era. About the role: Upvest is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to raise the bar on how we build, run and recover our systems. Our platform sits in the critical path for our clients and their end customers and as we scale reliability and availability become more crucial. In the near term, you’ll focus on three things: eliminating toil, improving incident management and observability. That means establishing the standards through automation and guardrails that make good engineering the default, turning our incident process into a robust and effective practice, and giving every team the telemetry to see what their services are doing in production. Over time, your scope grows into resilience architecture, chaos engineering and disaster preparedness - making sure our systems degrade gracefully and that we find weaknesses before our clients do. You’ll work closely with product engineering teams, embedding SRE practices into how they design, ship and operate, and mentoring engineers along the way. If you like the idea of setting technical direction for reliability across an organisation, and you measure your success by how rarely anyone has to think about you at 2am, this is the role for you. What you’ll do: Incident Excellence : transform how we respond to and learn from incidents, turning repeat problems into opportunities through robust runbooks and post-mortem culture. Reliability as Code : establish SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets that become the shared language of engineering velocity and stability. Automation Leverage : eliminate toil ruthlessly. Build tools that let engineers focus on building value for our clients. Defensive Architecture : establish SRE principles and patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheading, graceful degradation, intelligent rate limiting) to make our services resilient. Stress at Scale : validate system behavior under synthetic load and adversarial conditions, proving our defenses work to improve disaster preparedness. Proactive Defense : design chaos experiments, redundancy patterns, and failover strategies that validate resilience before customers ever see an issue. What you bring: Deep SRE Mastery : years in high-stakes environments (FinTech, payments, banking, trading, mission-critical SaaS) where downtime has real consequences. Technical Depth : hands-on expertise with SLOs, incident management, observability, automation, and the discipline of eliminating toil. Systems Thinking : you understand resilience architecture deeply and how to design systems that fail gracefully. Influence Without Authority : exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. You can change minds and shape culture through clarity and engineering excellence. Leadership : proven ability to mentor engineers, see projects through end-to-end and set technical direction in an engineering organisation. It’s great if you have: Investment Industry Fluency : understanding our domain means your SRE decisions align with business reality, not just technical ideals Stack Familiarity : experience with Golang, Kubernetes, GCP, Postgres, Kafka, or Datadog accelerates your impact How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. data.title: Junior Production Engineer
data.description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our Junior Production Engineer, you'll be right at the heart of our production floor — supporting day-to-day operations, driving continuous improvement, and helping us scale safely and efficiently as we grow. Your Responsibilities Provide day-to-day hands-on support in the production area, including the inspection of non-conforming (NOK) robot modules Independently run small-to-medium continuous improvement projects focused on enhancing production safety, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), and quality Own, create, and maintain comprehensive work instructions for all internal assemblies, and support the creation of training documentation Support the implementation of quality assurance processes and maintenance activities Support the creation of FMEAs for all new robot modules and take ownership of executing the resulting risk-mitigation tasks Support the team during production trials and cross-functional change management processes We're looking for someone who has: A Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a similar field First working experience (including internships or working student positions) in a (high-volume) production environment A strong hands-on mentality with a proactive, self-starter approach to problem-solving Highly adaptable and willing to support a wide variety of projects as the production area scales Nice-to-have: initial experience with ERP systems, time analysis, or Lean Manufacturing concepts Fluent in English and German About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. data.title: Global Service Specialist - Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
data.description: Description Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important. As our Global Service Specialist, based at our Munich HQ, you’ll be part of a rapid-deployment team that resolves complex and escalated technical issues across our worldwide installed base. You’ll step in where regional service teams and partners need deeper expertise, and support installations, commissioning, and repairs when situations require it. You’ll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You’ll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus. This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Act as the technical escalation point for regional service teams and distribution partners, resolving issues that require deeper system expertise. Deploy rapidly to customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia to resolve critical system issues and minimize downtime. Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of our quantum sensing systems when required, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams. Perform advanced troubleshooting, calibration, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems. Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when root causes go beyond service-level expertise. Work closely with Field Application Engineers, who focus on measurement execution and customer applications, to ensure a seamless customer experience. Support spare-parts planning and service logistics across the global installed base, ensuring critical parts are available for rapid response. Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development. Build trusted relationships with customers and partners through clear technical communication and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments. Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including escalation workflows, maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation. What is expected of you 5+ years of hands-on experience in field service, service support, or equipment engineering roles, ideally with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment. A proven track record of resolving escalated or complex system issues that first-line service could not solve. Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software. Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures. Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications. Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage. A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, especially under time pressure. Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with customers, partners, and internal teams. Willingness to travel internationally on a frequent basis, often at short notice, to support customers and partners across the US, Europe, and Asia. Fluency in English. Other languages (e.g. German, Mandarin, Korean) are a plus. A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act. data.title: Microsoft 365 Administrator (m/w/d)
data.description: Sie haben schon einmal einen gewachsenen Microsoft-365-Tenant aufgeräumt: Gruppen zusammengeführt, Rechte und Zugriffe neu geregelt und Richtlinien so aufgesetzt, dass alles verlässlich läuft? Und Sie möchten diese Verantwortung jetzt für ein Unternehmen mit Standorten in mehreren Ländern übernehmen? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit zuverlässigen Services begleiten. Warum diese Rolle? Die IT-Infrastruktur soll jetzt Schritt für Schritt sauber aufgestellt werden. Rollen, Gruppen und Gruppenrichtlinien sind über die Zeit entstanden und brauchen eine klare Ordnung. Zugleich soll der Tenant alle Standorte sauber abbilden, und der weitere Rollout von Microsoft 365 in die Organisation steht an. Weil Sie Ihre Vorstellung eines sauberen Tenants einbringen und die Verantwortung dafür tragen. Weil Sie die Roadmap für den weiteren Rollout von Anfang an prägen. Weil am Ende ein Backend steht, auf das sich das Unternehmen beim Wachsen verlassen kann. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie ordnen Rollen, Gruppen und Berechtigungen neu: Gruppen zusammenführen, Namenskonventionen festlegen, ein Rollenkonzept mit RBAC und Privileged Identity Management aufbauen, bei Bedarf mit Administrative Units je Land. Sie verantworten Identitäten und Zugriffe in Entra ID, je nach Umgebung hybrid mit lokalem Active Directory, einschließlich Conditional Access und MFA. Sie bereinigen bestehende Gruppenrichtlinien und überführen sie schrittweise nach Intune. Sie bauen Intune als Plattform für die Geräteverwaltung aus: Autopilot, Softwareverteilung, Compliance-Richtlinien sowie Smartphones und Tablets. Sie setzen Sicherheitsgrundlagen im Tenant um, darunter Defender-Basisschutz in Abstimmung mit dem externen SOC, und halten Lizenzen und Admin-Konten sauber. Sie betreuen Exchange Online, Teams und SharePoint auf technischer Ebene. Sie planen den weiteren Rollout von Microsoft 365 mit, bringen ihn in die Organisation und halten Standards schriftlich fest. Zur Einordnung: Die Rolle verantwortet das technische Backend von Microsoft 365, also Tenant, Identitäten, Berechtigungen, Richtlinien und Sicherheit. Sie konzipieren und setzen selbst um. Dabei arbeiten Sie im Infrastruktur-Team eng mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen an den Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika zusammen. Das bringen Sie mit Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug Mehrere Jahre Praxis in der Administration von Microsoft 365 im Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit mehreren Standorten oder Ländern Sicheren Umgang mit Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune und Exchange Online sowie Erfahrung in der Migration von Gruppenrichtlinien Automatisierung mit PowerShell und Microsoft Graph Projekterfahrung und die Fähigkeit, ein Thema eigenständig zu strukturieren und zum Abschluss zu bringen Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen wie MS-102, MD-102, SC-300 oder AZ-104 sowie Erfahrung mit Microsoft Defender Das erwartet Sie Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema, in einem Infrastruktur-Team mit erfahrener Führung, die Rückhalt gibt Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung Interesse? data.title: Team Lead Accounting (m/w/d)
data.description: Was wir suchen Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. data.title: DevOps & Data Architecture - Intern/Fulltime
data.description: About Heidi Systems Heidi Systems is building the data infrastructure layer for buildings and energy. We help property owners and managers digitize metering, consumption data, reporting and billing in one of Europe's largest and most outdated infrastructure markets. We're hiring a senior engineer to own DevOps and data infrastructure. You'll be responsible for how our systems get built, deployed, monitored and kept running. And you'll make the architecture calls together with the founders. Tasks What you'll own • Our deployment pipeline and production environment, end to end (CI/CD, containers, servers) • Monitoring, alerting and incident response, so problems show up before customers notice them • Data ingestion and processing for meter, gateway and building data, including MQTT/IoT streams • Database operations: Postgres setup, clustering, backups, performance • Backend services in Go and TypeScript • Validating and transforming high-volume device and consumption data • Debugging real-world issues across gateways, MQTT, APIs and databases • Internal tooling that automates our operations • Architecture decisions with the founding team, plus the engineering standards the rest of the team builds on Requirements Who we're looking for You've run production infrastructure before and you know what breaks at 2am. You make decisions on your own, explain the trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome. You're a great fit if you: • Have several years of hands-on experience in a DevOps, SRE, platform or backend role with production responsibility • Have built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments yourself • Write strong Go and/or TypeScript • Have run Postgres (or a comparable relational database) in production • Have set up monitoring and logging and handled real incidents • Can design a system from scratch and defend the choices Bonus: MQTT, IoT or time-series data, bare-metal/VPS setups (we run on Hetzner), experience in energy or real estate. Tech stack • Go, TypeScript • Postgres • Docker, GitHub Actions, GHCR • Hetzner, Caddy • MQTT / IoT data streams • YAML, TOML Benefits Why join us • You own the infrastructure of a product that's live with customers • Direct line to the founders, short decision paths • Your setup becomes the standard: you define how we build and run things • Real hardware, real data: meters, gateways, buildings • A big, outdated market that's only starting to digitize Location Living in or relocating to Berlin is required. data.description: Du liebst es, Events auf die Beine zu stellen, und weißt, wie man Social-Media-Kanäle lebendig hält? Dann passt du zu uns. Als Marketing Manager sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Messen und Veranstaltungen reibungslos laufen und unsere Social-Media-Kanäle konsequent bespielt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit der Marketingleitung zusammen, hältst im Team die Fäden zusammen und wächst mit der Zeit in weitere Marketingbereiche hinein. Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel. Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Marketingteam, in dem deine Ideen gehört und umgesetzt werden. Deine Aufgaben: Du recherchierst und bewertest neue Messen und Veranstaltungen und bringst sie für uns an den Start. Du planst und setzt Messen, Netzwerkveranstaltungen, Webinare und Objektvorstellungen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung um. Du übernimmst die komplette Organisation rund um jedes Event: Anmeldung, Standplanung, Hotel und Reise, Material sowie die Abstimmung mit Ausstellern und Dienstleistern. Du begleitest eigene Formate wie Tage der offenen Tür, Preisbewerbungen und Postmailings. Du bereitest jedes Event sauber nach: Du übergibst Kontakte ins CRM, sammelst Fotos und Material und hältst Learnings fest. Du steuerst unsere Social-Media-Kanäle (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube), planst Beiträge nach Redaktionsplan ein und veröffentlichst sie. Du betreust Stories, zum Beispiel Einblicke hinter die Kulissen und von unterwegs, und kümmerst dich um das Community-Management. Du hältst Kanäle und Profile aktuell und gestaltest die Ausrichtung der Kanäle aktiv mit. Du recherchierst Themen, schreibst Texte und Captions und erstellst Briefings für Grafik und Video. Du lieferst Werbetexte und Kampagnenideen zu, vor allem zu Events und Content-Themen, und bereitest die Event-Bewerbung gemeinsam mit unserem Performance Marketing Manager vor. Du bereitest Marketing-Sprints und Jour fixes vor und nach, pflegst die Mitschriften und hältst offene Punkte nach. Das bringst du mit: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Event- oder Medienmanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Berufserfahrung im Event- und Messemanagement, im Social-Media-Management oder idealerweise in beidem. Sicherer Umgang mit Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und YouTube sowie ein gutes Gespür für Inhalte, die ankommen. Stilsichere Texte: Du formulierst Captions, Beiträge und Werbetexte, die auf den Punkt sind. Organisationstalent und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig laufen. Ein freundliches und souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Ausstellern, Dienstleistern und Gästen. Reisebereitschaft für Messen und Veranstaltungen. Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren Tool sowie mit einem CRM ist ein Plus. Erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Microsoft Copilot und Lust, dein Wissen darin auszubauen und KI im Arbeitsalltag gezielt einzusetzen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Wünschenswert: Interesse an Immobilien und Kapitalanlagen. Was wir dir bieten: Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn in einem Unternehmen, das dringend benötigte Pflegeplätze schafft. Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit 40 Stunden pro Woche. Attraktives Jahresgehalt (Fixgehalt zuzüglich Bonusregelung). 28 Tage Urlaub; zusätzlich hast du an Rosenmontag ganz sowie an Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei. Einen Gesundheitsbonus in Form eines Personal Trainers. Einen modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz in der Düsseldorfer Innenstadt, gut erreichbar mit Bus und Bahn. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und gezielte Weiterbildung, auch im Umgang mit KI. Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: Du wächst mit der Zeit in weitere Marketingbereiche hinein. So arbeiten wir: Wir arbeiten bewusst gemeinsam vor Ort. Die Stelle ist eine Präsenzstelle in unserem Büro in Düsseldorf. Kurze Wege, schnelle Abstimmung und ein Team, das sich kennt, gehören für uns zur Qualität unserer Arbeit. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! data.title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d, Vollzeit)
data.description: Du steuerst bezahlte Kampagnen nicht nach Gefühl, sondern nach Zahlen, und weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was einen guten Lead von einem teuren unterscheidet? Dann passt du zu uns. Als Performance Marketing Manager setzt du unsere bezahlten Kampagnen auf, steuerst und wertest sie aus, damit qualifizierte Leads bei unserem Vertrieb ankommen. Du bist der Filter zwischen Anzeige und Beratungsgespräch und verantwortest deine Kampagnen vom ersten Tag an eigenständig. Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel. Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketingleitung und Vertrieb zusammen und siehst direkt, welchen Beitrag deine Kampagnen zum Geschäftserfolg leisten. Deine Aufgaben: Du baust Kampagnen in Meta, Google und LinkedIn auf und steuerst sie im Rahmen eines festen Quartalsbudgets. Du baust Google Ads als eigenen Schwerpunkt aus: Search und Display, Keywords, negative Keywords und Suchintentionen. Du richtest ein sauberes Tracking ein, inklusive UTM-Parametern, und verknüpfst die Kampagnen mit HubSpot. Du optimierst laufende Kampagnen kontinuierlich über Zielgruppen, Gebote, Creatives und A/B-Tests. Du entwickelst Wording und Framing für Objekt- und Rabattaktionen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung. Du briefst Bild-Creatives bei unserem Digital Designer und Videos bei unserem Video Editor und prüfst sie vor dem Go-live auf Briefing und Plattformformate. Du wertest deine Kampagnen aus: Kosten pro Lead, Anteil qualifizierter Leads, Terminquote und Kosten pro Abschluss. Du pflegst das Marketing-Dashboard in HubSpot auf Kampagnenebene und lieferst die Kennzahlen für das monatliche Reporting an die Marketingleitung. Du prüfst und qualifizierst eingehende Leads vor, bevor sie in ein Beratungsgespräch gehen, und spielst die Rückmeldungen zur Lead-Qualität in Kampagnen und Framing zurück. Das bringst du mit: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Performance Marketing, in der du Kampagnen eigenverantwortlich aufgesetzt, gesteuert und ausgewertet hast. Nachweisbare Praxis mit Meta Ads und Google Ads (Search und Display); Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Ads ist ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Leadgenerierung mit klarem Fokus auf Lead-Qualität und Kosten pro Abschluss, nicht nur auf Lead-Menge, idealerweise bei erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten wie Immobilien, Kapitalanlagen oder Finanzdienstleistungen. Sicherer Umgang mit Tracking, UTM-Parametern und Conversion-Messung sowie mit Analyse- und Reporting-Tools. Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Tool sowie mit einem CRM. Verantwortung für feste Werbebudgets und die Fähigkeit, Budgets zielgerichtet einzusetzen und einzuhalten. Ein analytisches, zahlengetriebenes Denken und gleichzeitig ein gutes Gespür für Botschaften, die Zielgruppen überzeugen. Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du brauchst keine lange Einarbeitung, sondern legst nach kurzer Einführung in unsere Prozesse direkt los. Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Microsoft Copilot und Lust, KI im Arbeitsalltag gezielt einzusetzen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Was wir dir bieten: Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn in einem Unternehmen, das dringend benötigte Pflegeplätze schafft. Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit 40 Stunden pro Woche. Attraktives Jahresgehalt (Fixgehalt zuzüglich Bonusregelung). 28 Tage Urlaub; zusätzlich hast du an Rosenmontag ganz sowie an Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei. Einen Gesundheitsbonus in Form eines Personal Trainers. Einen modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz in der Düsseldorfer Innenstadt, gut erreichbar mit Bus und Bahn. Eine kompakte Einführung in unsere Prozesse und Tools, danach volle Verantwortung für deine Kampagnen. Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst, wie wir Performance Marketing und Google Ads aufbauen. So arbeiten wir: Wir arbeiten bewusst gemeinsam vor Ort. Die Stelle ist eine Präsenzstelle in unserem Büro in Düsseldorf. Kurze Wege, schnelle Abstimmung und ein Team, das sich kennt, gehören für uns zur Qualität unserer Arbeit. Deine Bewerbung: Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Bewirb dich bitte über den Button auf dieser Seite. Gern kannst du auch ein bis zwei Beispiele von Kampagnen mitschicken, die du verantwortet hast, mit den Kennzahlen, auf die du stolz bist. Wir melden uns schnellstmöglich bei dir. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! data.title: Customer Success Associate (m/w/d)
data.description: Über Sparrks Sparrks ist eine digitale 1:1- und Team-Coaching Plattform, die Unternehmen mit über 280 zertifizierten Executive Coaches verbindet und Führungskräfte sowie Talente durch personalisiertes Coaching nachhaltig in ihrer Entwicklung unterstützt. Das Team in Berlin arbeitet daran, wirksame Personalentwicklung für DAX-Unternehmen, Top-Beratungen und führende Scale-ups zugänglich zu machen. Für die Betreuung unserer Kunden und Coachees suchen wir Dich als engagierte*n Customer Success Associate (m/w/d). Deine Aufgaben Du bist Hauptansprechperson für unsere Kunden, meist Leitungen aus HR oder Learning & Development, sowie für die Coachees selbst. Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung unserer Coaching-Programme. Du bereitest regelmäßige Kundentermine mit Datenanalysen und Präsentationen vor, führst sie durch und stellst die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden sicher. Du treibst strategische und operative Sales-Aktivitäten bei Bestandskunden voran und entwickelst die Accounts zu ihrem vollen Potenzial. Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts ein und wächst gemeinsam mit uns in einem spannenden Markt. Dein Profil Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der BWL, Psychologie, Kommunikation oder einer vergleichbaren Richtung. Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Account Management, Partnermanagement, Recruiting, Service, Community Management oder im direkten Kundenkontakt. Einen offenen, positiven und beziehungsorientierten Kommunikationsstil, mit dem Du überzeugst. Geschick im Aufbau von Beziehungen und die Fähigkeit, auch schwierige Gespräche mit Klarheit und Wertschätzung zu führen. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Daten fundierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen. Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, mit der Du mühelos mehrere Bälle in der Luft hältst. Begeisterung für Coaching und Startups, eine eigene Coaching-Ausbildung ist ein Bonus. Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Vorteile Eine attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütung. Eine steile Lernkurve, viel Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung eines wachsenden Unternehmens. Persönliches 1:1-Coaching durch unsere Top Executive Coaches. Ein schönes Office im Herzen von Berlin (alternativ hybrid) und ein dynamisches Team mit tollen Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Alle klassischen „Startup-Perks“ wie frisches Obst, Snacks, Getränke, guter Kaffee & Teamevents. Sparrks steht für Chancengleichheit, deshalb freuen wir uns über Deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Deinem ethnischen Hintergrund, Geschlecht oder Deiner sexuellen Orientierung. Deine ersten Monate bei Sparrks Du übernimmst von Anfang an viel Verantwortung und eigene Kundenaccounts und arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern und unserem Customer-Success-Team zusammen. Du lernst unsere Kunden, Coaches und Programme kennen und wirst schnell zur festen Ansprechperson für Deine Accounts. Bewirb Dich auch dann, wenn Dein Profil nicht alle Anforderungen zu einhundert Prozent erfüllt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

data.title: Working Student (Werkstudent) HR Operations (m/f/d)
data.description: Who We Are Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com . Who You Are We are currently searching for a Working Student (Werkstudent) HR Operations to join our team in Germany and support our HR Operations team across the full employee lifecycle. This role gives you hands-on insight into German HR administration, payroll and labor law, and the chance to contribute to HR projects in an international environment. What You Will Do Support onboarding and offboarding processes, from preparing welcome documents and system set-up to exit paperwork. Maintain and update staff records in our HR system (HiBob) and the digital personnel file Prepare employment contracts, contract amendments, employment confirmations, reference letters and other certificates using our templates. Help collate monthly payroll input (starters, leavers, salary changes, bonuses) for German payroll and prepare it for review. Track key dates such as probation periods, contract end dates and work permit/visa expiries, and keep documentation audit-ready. Support communication with external partners and vendors, such as our payroll provider, tax advisors and benefits providers. Support HR projects, including process improvements, HiBob optimization and Compensation & Benefits administration. What You Will Bring Currently enrolled as a student at a German university (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field. Availability of 16–20 hours per week during the semester for at least 6 months (more hours possible during semester breaks). First practical experience in HR, e.g. through an internship or previous working student role, is a plus. Strong interest in HR processes and German labor law. Confident with MS Office or Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets; experience with HR systems (e.g. HiBob) is a plus. Fluent German and very good English, both spoken and written. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a discreet approach to confidential employee data. Hands-on, proactive mindset and eagerness to learn in a fast-paced, global environment. What We Offer Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve: Support your long-term financial security with our Allianz Corporate Pension Scheme Pick what matters most to you in our Personalized Benefits Platform , with a budget of €100/month: mobility support (BVG/HVV), internet allowance, daycare subsidy, Urban Sports Club membership, personal development, and shopping vouchers Support your mental well-being with our Nilo Health Workplace Mental Health Solution Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars, and level up your language skills through our German/English classes Recharge with 27 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays … and even more reasons to join us! data.title: Account Executive, Influencer Marketing
data.description: Position: Account Specialist The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German. The Role: As an Account Specialist , you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives. The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Top 5 Responsibilities: INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING – Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes. INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives. AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients. CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION - Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating. PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT - Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve. What Success Looks Like: BY 3 MONTHS: The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place. You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation. You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured. By 6 MONTHS: You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications. Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively. You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns. Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns. You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance By 1 YEAR: You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams. You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies. You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development. Qualities of the Ideal Candidate Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own Works independently with minimal supervision Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners Qualifications & Skills: Fluency in German 2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience Ability to travel up to 15% Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc. WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching Open Paid Time Off Summer & Holiday company-wide shut-down weeks in July and December Volunteer and Birthday Time Off Focus Fridays Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! Target Salary is €37–44K depending on location and experience. Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. #LI-REMOTE *GLSDR #LI-MG1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

data.title: Applied AI Engineer
data.description: About Us Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities. Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies. In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition. Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship . About the Role As a member of the Tech Data, AI & UX team allocated to European & Asian Power Trading in Berlin, you will build the services, infrastructure, and AI & data platforms that power the business, enabling teams to improve their data-driven decisions and connect innovative products. As part of this Joint Venture, the Applied AI Engineer will help to evolve ECTP’s AI & Agentic platforms – a strategic, firm-wide initiative led by the Tech Data, AI & UX team. The role provides hands-on exposure to the cutting edge of enterprise AI, working alongside experienced data engineer, architects and quant developers in a live, production-grade environment. You will work closely with trading desk and Technology teams to build core agentic infrastructure, integrate tooling via AWS Lambda and MCP servers, develop agent skills, and configure knowledge bases across user, chat, agent, and application contexts. You will explore and evaluate open-source and proprietary connectors within the rapidly evolving LLM and Generative AI ecosystem, and help roll out individual productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude Code. All solutions will be hosted securely within Engelhart’s internal network, with models deployed in a dedicated VPC and governed access to firm data, with a strong preference for AWS-native and Bedrock-based architectures. This will be a full-time role, owning the following responsibilities : Collaborate with the trading desk to supercharge their research capabilities and data-driven insights by extending Engelhart's core AI and agentic platform to address new trading desk requirements. Assist in the set-up and configuration of core agentic AI infrastructure, including orchestration layers, agent runtimes, and supporting services, deployed securely within Engelhart’s AWS VPC. Build and maintain agent tooling integrations via AWS Lambda functions and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, enabling agents to interact with firm data, APIs, and internal systems. Develop agent skills and configure knowledge bases, including document stores, vector databases (e.g. Postgres with pgvector, AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases), and retrieval pipelines for user, chat, agent, and application contexts. Research, evaluate, and help integrate open-source and proprietary accelerators, connectors, and frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, etc) into the platform, assessing fitness for purpose in a regulated, IP-sensitive environment. Support the deployment and end-user adoption of individual AI productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot and Claude Code, ensuring secure configuration and appropriate access controls within Engelhart’s internal network. Contribute to technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and internal knowledge sharing on AI tooling, design decisions, and implementation patterns to support team learning and continuity. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to iteratively test and improve agentic workflows, gathering feedback and translating it into technical improvements. About You This person will be a technically minded and genuinely curious person who is excited about the transformative potential of AI and wants to go beyond surface-level tooling – you want to understand how things work and help build them. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, energised by fast-moving technology landscapes, and take pride in writing clean, well-structured code. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to something that has real, visible impact within a live business setting. The following education, experiences and skills are essential for application: Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or related technical undergraduate degree. A genuine passion for AI, Large Language Models, and Generative AI. Not just as a user, but with curiosity about how they work and how to build with them. Proficient in Python, with hands-on experience writing scripts, working with APIs, or building small applications – whether through coursework, personal projects, or hackathons. Familiarity with cloud concepts or services (preference for AWS), containerisation (Docker), or REST APIs – even if only at an introductory or project level. A proactive, self-directed learning style – able to research unfamiliar technologies, synthesise documentation, and form a view on trade-offs with limited guidance. Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues, and to work effectively in a small, fast-moving team. A collaborative, team-oriented mindset, with the confidence to contribute ideas, ask questions, and engage actively with engineers, data scientists, and business users. An organised approach to work, with attention to detail, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapid change, with the resilience to iterate quickly, adapt to new findings, and thrive in a technology landscape that evolves week to week. In addition, the following criteria is not required, but highly desirable for this role: Foundational knowledge of energy trading markets, including core concepts like balancing mechanism operations, Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), and Virtual Power Plants (VPPs). Prior exposure to LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar; experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma); or familiarity with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent managed AI services. Experience with version control (Git) and basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines or infrastructure-as-code (e.g. AWS CloudFormation, CDK). Understanding of prompt engineering techniques, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or multi-agent system design patterns. Participation in AI/ML hackathons, open-source contributions, personal projects involving LLMs or automation, or active engagement with the AI development community (e.g. Hugging Face, GitHub, LangChain forums). Portuguese as a second language. What we offer Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan. 28 days of annual holiday entitlement plus Berlin public holidays. €3,000 per year contribution to a private pension scheme on your behalf. €20 monthly subsidy towards BVG tickets. €25 monthly subsidy towards ClassPass membership. A subsidy for German language courses to help you immerse yourself in the local culture. A sociable working environment with an open, international culture. We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

data.title: Head of Revenue Operations
data.description: At Haut.AI , we make skin measurable. We give beauty and wellness brands skin intelligence: AI that analyzes skin from a selfie, simulates how it may change over time, and guides every consumer to the right products. Our technology, including AI Skin Analysis, SkinGPT and Skin.Chat, powers personalized, science-backed experiences online and in store. Today, more than 100 global beauty brands use our technology, including enterprise companies like Neutrogena, Beiersdorf, Ulta Beauty, Grupo Boticário and OLAY. We are looking for a Head of Revenue to own Haut.AI ’s full commercial engine: new business and customer success in one function and lead a team of six exceptional teammates. This is a player-coach role reporting directly to our CEO. What you will do: Own the revenue number. You own new business, renewals and expansion, plus the forecast and the commercial KPIs. You give leadership a clear view of where things really stand. Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach and develop three Account Executives and Account Managers. Run weekly pipeline reviews and one-on-ones that focus on growth as much as on numbers. Coach deal by deal and account by account. Join calls and demos, and give specific feedback while it is fresh. Set a clear standard for discovery, proposals, pricing and demo prep. Carry the biggest deals yourself. Lead a small set of our largest, most strategic enterprise opportunities. Personally manage our most valuable client relationships at senior level. Keep complex buying groups moving. Enterprise beauty deals involve brand and marketing, e-commerce, IT, data privacy, legal and procurement. You map the group, align it and keep it moving toward signature. Build the system the team runs on. This means playbooks and objection handling, and a clean handoff from Account Executive to Account Manager once a deal closes. It also means CS operations from onboarding to renewal and expansion, and health scores that surface risk early. Put AI to work across revenue. Find where AI cuts busywork and sharpens decisions: call prep, deal reviews, proposals, account health. Get hands-on with the tools; don’t stop at writing the plan. Stay close to clients and bring back what you learn. Sit in on onboarding and business reviews. Turn client feedback into real input for Product and Marketing, and bring pricing and packaging signals back from the market. What makes you a fit: An experienced commercial leader. You have 8+ years in B2B SaaS commercial roles, including 3+ years leading a team. Ideally you have owned both new business and account management or customer success. A player-coach. You have built and led a commercial team, and you still enjoy running a deal, reviewing the proposal and joining the call. Your team follows your example. At home with enterprise. You have closed complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders and long sales cycles. You are comfortable in the room with senior leaders, with exceptional English and real executive presence. A high-agency builder. You have built commercial processes, playbooks and KPI frameworks yourself, not just run someone else’s. You would rather put a working playbook in front of the team this week than perfect it for next quarter. Evidence over opinion. You know HubSpot or a similar CRM inside out. You read call recordings, check CRM hygiene and turn activity data into clear next actions. You can explain a forecast in plain language. You own outcomes, not activities, and you finish what you start, even with a lot on your plate in a small, fast-moving remote team. AI-native in how you work. You use AI tools daily and have clear views on where they help a revenue team and where they do not. Curious about skin science. You want to understand how our science turns into business value for beauty brands, and you learn fast. Nice to have: experience selling to beauty, retail or e-commerce brands and retailers, selling API or platform products, or selling across Europe and North America. Why Haut.AI Competitive base salary plus a clear, transparent bonus structure Fully remote, with flexibility across UK and EU time zones A MacBook and the equipment you need for a productive remote setup Paid time off: vacation, personal days, sick leave and Estonian public holidays A rare chance to build the whole commercial function, with your fingerprints on everything A collaborative, supportive team that ships Direct impact on product and company growth Room to grow at the intersection of AI, science and beauty Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

data.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
data.description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process. This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both. How we're set up Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do. We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves. What you'll own Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible. The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours. Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself. A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so. Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad. Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth. Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it. How we expect leaders to operate Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems. Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line. End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally. No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it. Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against. Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions. Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too. What you bring 4 to 6+ years in engineering management , with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers. A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical. Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why. Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully. Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery. Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it. Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices : code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing. Strong pluses Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build. Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation. Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it. What this role is, and isn't It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
