data.title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
data.description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link. Bring-Up & Debug: Lead firmware bring-up on new boards and sensors, debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and in-system probes. Source Control & Build: Keep RTL under version control with a repeatable, automated build, and document designs to the standard our ISO 9001 design control process requires. Reviews & Support: Contribute to design reviews, and support the software team and customers during field integration. Experience & Skills: Essential: Strong proficiency in Verilog, and a solid grounding in RTL design, synthesis and timing closure. Hands-on experience with AMD-Xilinx Vivado and its toolchain. Experience writing your own testbenches and verifying a design in simulation before hardware. Experience bringing up firmware on real hardware and debugging it in the lab. Experience with at least one high-speed interface or bus at RTL level. Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in. Working with complex, existing codebases and seamlessly integrating new functionality with minimal disruption. Desirable: SystemVerilog, and verification practices beyond directed testbenches. Comfortable working in Linux operating systems. Exposure to any of PCIe, AXI interface, USB3, Ethernet, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS or Camera Link. C, C++ or Python for embedded software integration and test automation. Experience with image sensors, time-of-flight, TDCs or single-photon detection. Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, and reading schematics during debug. Educational Background: Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2-5 years' experience in FPGA and digital design. Key Attributes & Behaviours: Rigour: Disciplined about verification - you would rather find it in simulation than on the bench. Debugging: Systematic when the fault could be in the RTL, the board or the sensor, and comfortable with the instruments that tell you which. Clarity: Writes documentation and code that colleagues can pick up without you in the room. Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA. Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through. Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move. Success Indicators: Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench. Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly. Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work. Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics At Singular Photonics, we are committed to fostering a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. As an FPGA Firmware Engineer, you will benefit from: Pension: 5% company contribution. Share Options: Participation in the Company EMI Share Option Scheme, so you share in the growth you help build. Enhanced Annual Leave: 35 days paid annual leave per year, inclusive of UK public holidays. Hybrid Working: Primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week (full time worker). Career Growth: Work on silicon and systems few engineers get near, with the chance to shape how we do FPGA development as the team grows. Additional Benefits: [Cycle to work and private medical insurance (once implemented) Why Join Us This position offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of SPAD sensor technology, driving innovation and shaping future applications in photonics and imaging. At Singular Photonics you will be part of a passionate, close-knit team, where the work you do is visible in the product and in the hands of customers. Location & Work Environment Based at Orchard Brae House, Queensferry Road, Edinburgh. This is a full-time, permanent role. The work is hands-on with hardware in our lab, so it is primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week. Right to work in the UK is essential. data.title: Senior Product Manager
data.description: Senior Product Manager Location: UK (remote) Job Description About Us Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI. We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery. Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon. We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us. About the Role As a Senior Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end, from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious. You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve. If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role. Responsibilities Set product direction and priorities , bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities. Define problems and experiences before solutions , creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution. Lead product initiatives end-to-end , from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace. Make sound product decisions and trade-offs , balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations. Develop product opportunities with external partners , building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market. Orchestrate successful launches and adoption , working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build. Communicate with clarity throughout , ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results. About you You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end , from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes. You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward. You operate with independence and initiative : you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities. You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product. You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering , understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions. You’re an exceptional communicator , able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business. You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally , building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations. You have a strong sense of product and user experience , caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered. The benefits Competitive salary with generous stock options Pension with employer contributions (NEST) Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Privacy Policy: We process personal information submitted as part of your application in accordance with the Reachdesk Candidate Privacy Notice. Please review Reachdesk’s Privacy Policy here: www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

data.title: Account Executive, Influencer Marketing
data.description: Position: Account Specialist The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German. The Role: As an Account Specialist , you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives. The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Top 5 Responsibilities: INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING – Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes. INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives. AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients. CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION - Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating. PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT - Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve. What Success Looks Like: BY 3 MONTHS: The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place. You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation. You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured. By 6 MONTHS: You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications. Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively. You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns. Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns. You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance By 1 YEAR: You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams. You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies. You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development. Qualities of the Ideal Candidate Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own Works independently with minimal supervision Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners Qualifications & Skills: Fluency in German 2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience Ability to travel up to 15% Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc. WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching Open Paid Time Off Summer & Holiday company-wide shut-down weeks in July and December Volunteer and Birthday Time Off Focus Fridays Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! Target Salary is £27–37K depending on location and experience. Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. data.title: Head of Product Design
data.description: Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator. Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do. Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance. We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed. This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions. Job responsibilities Website product strategy Set the product vision, principles and roadmap for Thoughtworks.com Prioritize work around customer and business outcomes rather than requests for individual pages Connect the website roadmap to Thoughtworks’ go-to-market priorities, propositions and major company launches. Customer journeys and experience Build a deep understanding of our audiences, including enterprise buyers, technology leaders, practitioners, partners, prospective employees and alumni community Design connected journeys that help people move from a question/problem/need to relevant services, expertise, evidence and action, where the site fuels journeys on AI platforms that might never have users interact with our site Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey. Narrative, copy and content quality Own the quality and coherence of the website narrative, copy and information architecture Translate complex technology services and Thoughtworks expertise into clear, credible experiences for different audiences Challenge unclear propositions, duplicated content, unsupported claims and pages that do not serve a defined customer need Work with the central Content team, service-line marketers and subject-matter experts, while keeping accountability for how content works within the overall experience Work with content operations to establish reusable content patterns, editorial standards and clear ownership for maintaining important content. Experiences for people and agents Ensure the website is useful and understandable to human visitors, search engines and AI assistants Partner with the SEO and LLM Discoverability Lead to improve how Thoughtworks is found, interpreted and represented to support buyers in their decision making process Shape requirements for structured content, metadata, evidence, content relationships and reusable information Balance machine readability with strong human storytelling, accessibility and brand expression. Publishing model for the AI era Own the spec for redesigning the publishing workflow from brief through design, production, approval, release and ongoing improvement Work with the GTM tech and Global IT teams to replace manual, error-prone production with reusable patterns, clearer decision rights and proportionate automation Identify where AI can improve research, prototyping, content preparation, metadata, accessibility checks, quality assurance and content maintenance Turn good judgment into practical standards, templates, playbooks and automated checks Build a model that allows teams to move faster without lowering the quality bar or creating uncontrolled publishing. data.description: About the job Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence. You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements. Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics. You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known. The team and culture The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together. We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems. You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other. One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are. What we're looking for Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems. Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence. Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams. Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. data.title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
data.description: 500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating. Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down. With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better. The job Principal Infrastructure Engineer More than 80 million women open Flo every month to understand their bodies and their health. Every one of those sessions runs on infrastructure we build, and the data behind it is as personal as data gets. Keeping that fast and private at this scale is the job. Velocity runs the platform that every Flo engineer builds on: Kubernetes on AWS, the data stores behind our services, and the golden paths that let product teams ship without needing to be infrastructure experts. We treat our internal developers as our customers. You will: Own the foundations: Design and run the Kubernetes and data infrastructure behind 80 million monthly active users, and make it boring in the best sense. Turn expertise into self-service: Take what you know about running clusters and databases well, and build it into the defaults so product teams get it for free. What You Will Do Kubernetes at scale: Architect and evolve our EKS estate: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, networking, autoscaling, workload isolation, and the Helm and Terraform that deploy onto it. Data infrastructure: Shape how our services use PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka. Set the patterns for provisioning, access, backup, failover and capacity, so teams aren't solving these problems one service at a time. Golden paths: Build self-service tooling and Terraform modules that give product teams autonomy without sacrificing stability or security. Reliability: Lead resilience work, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing and a sustainable on-call rotation. Privacy at scale: Support the infrastructure behind privacy features such as our TIME-recognised "Anonymous Mode", and keep us SOC2, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified while handling some of the most sensitive data there is. Observability: Make sure metrics, logs and traces tell us something is wrong before our users do. What You Bring Experience: Many years in infrastructure, platform, SRE or DevOps roles running high-traffic, distributed systems in production. You have operated at Principal or Staff scope, setting direction across teams as well as delivering. Kubernetes depth: You have run Kubernetes in production for real workloads, ideally EKS. You can explain what happens between kubectl apply and a pod serving traffic, and you have debugged it when it didn't. Data infrastructure awareness: You understand how PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka behave under load and when they fail: connection limits, replication lag, hot partitions, consumer lag, retention. You don't need to have been a DBA, but you know what good looks like and when to ask for help. AWS and infrastructure as code: Strong AWS knowledge and fluent Terraform. Coding experience in Go or Python is a plus. Communication: A doc-first habit, and the ability to bring distributed product teams with you. AI first: you will have seen the impact AI automation is having on development teams and the software delivery lifecycle, and have strong ideas on how infrastructure should support it. Bonus Points Hardening infrastructure for high-compliance or security-sensitive environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI). Running managed data services in AWS (RDS, Aurora, MSK, DynamoDB) at scale, including migrations and major version upgrades. Scaling consumer platforms with millions of concurrent users. Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, CKA or CKS. Why Join Flo? High impact: Flo is used by 1 in 4 women aged 18–44 in the US, and has raised $200M to build what comes next. Autonomy: We hire experts and trust them to deliver. Modern stack at scale: EKS, Terraform, Kafka, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Sentry, serving more than 80 million people a month. Annual Salary Range (ranges may vary based on skills and experience) £130,000 — £150,000 GBP How we work We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar. You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it. What you'll get We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like: Competitive salary and annual reviews Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks Diversity, equity and inclusion Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our privacy notice for job applicants . data.description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed. The Team You Will Lead You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources. Context Switching is the Norm You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve. Agility over Silos Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum. Focus Management Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed. The Team You Will Lead You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources. Context Switching is the Norm You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve. Agility over Silos Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum. Focus Management Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time. As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will: People Leadership & Talent Development Team Management Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management. Formal Training & Growth Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports. Recruitment & Retention Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture. Culture of Learning Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference. Strategic & Operational Management Budget & Capacity Planning Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware. Risk & Contingency Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity. Procedure & Frameworks Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards. Prioritisation Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations. Technical Support & Oversight Performance Optimisation Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them. Visual Documentation Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor. Hybrid Estate Management Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments. Unblocking Issues Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover. General Duties On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations. Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Leadership & Management Competencies Proven Management Experience Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc). Project Management Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment. Communication Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. Goal Oriented You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met. ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts. Technical Environment & Team Capabilities Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration. Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey. Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation. Innovation & Debt Management A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt. Advanced Containerization Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems. Observability Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana). Data Streaming Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid. Web & Storage Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster. Tooling Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Version Control strong understanding of Git and version control best practices. Why This Role? If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role. data.title: Principal Technical Consultant
data.description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. As a Professional Services Technical Consultant, you will play a technical role in the architecture and successful installation, integration, and deployment of Identity and Access solutions in our clients' environments. You will also assist our implementation partners in that process. You will report to the Director of Professional Services. You will: Deliver technical consulting to our customers and partners from various industries including financial services, manufacturing, government, utilities, and more. Evaluate client business, process, systems, and technology requirements and advise clients on best practices to help guide and solidify proposed designs. Consult with clients to assess current problem states, establish desired future states, and make solution recommendations. Participate in the detailed solution design, implementation, and delivery of Ping Identity IAM product solutions to our clients. Work with customers to install, deploy, and configure Ping Identity solutions to meet the customer's requirements. Collaborate with Ping Internal teams on escalated customer issues requiring deployment expertise. Participate in services pre-sales processes including presentation of effort size, best practices, and feasibility studies. Develop materials for providing technical consulting (e.g., best practices, report templates, delivery guides, knowledge base articles). Help partners ensure they design an architecture aligned to Ping best practices for a successful customer deployment. Mentor and assist in the development of internal and external technical resources. Lead technical delivery from discovery and design through implementation, testing, production readiness, and handover, coordinating dependencies and surfacing delivery risks early. Design and validate secure, scalable, highly available IAM deployments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including integration, operational, and disaster-recovery considerations. Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues by analysing logs, traces, configurations, and network behaviour; work with Support and Product Engineering to drive resolution where needed. Define and execute technical validation activities, including integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing, and support cutover and go-live planning. Produce clear implementation documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials so customer and partner teams can operate and support the solution after delivery. Balance strong security controls with a seamless user experience when shaping identity journeys and recommendations. You have: 5+ years of experience working in a consulting capacity with a minimum of 2 years working directly in the Identity and Access Management space within a large organization or enterprise Background in a consulting capacity within the Identity and Access Management space, including practical System Integration and Implementation experience A capability-maturity approach to IAM deployments Comfortable with subjects such as TCP/IP networking, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, LDAP, and Data Stores Experience with Java/JavaScript/Groovy, HTML/CSS to support web application development Experience in effort estimates and sizing of projects Self-motivated, willing to take initiative, organized, able to work unaccompanied, and manage communications appropriately Bachelor of Science in a related field (e.g. Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Information Systems) or equivalent work-related level of experience Availability to travel up to 50% of the time Outstanding cross-functional cooperation skills in particular with our Go-To-Market units. Excellent communication, both verbal and written Practical experience integrating IAM platforms with enterprise directories, applications, APIs, and identity systems, including federation, authentication, and user lifecycle or provisioning flows. Experience with identity standards and protocols such as SCIM, HTTP/REST APIs, and common directory and federation patterns, in addition to OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, FIDO and LDAP. Experience designing or delivering IAM solutions in cloud, hybrid, or on-premises environments, including deployment, upgrade, resilience, and operational support considerations. Strong diagnostic skills across application, identity, and network layers, with experience using logs and traces to isolate and resolve integration issues. Experience planning and carrying out technical testing, production cutovers, and transition to customer or partner operations. Ability to facilitate technical discovery and design workshops, explain trade-offs clearly, and adapt recommendations to customer constraints and desired outcomes. Experience working within structured delivery practices, including managing technical risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes across a customer engagement. You have an advantage if: Computer and Software Security certifications ForgeRock or Ping training badges/certifications Skills with DevOps best practices, including deployment automation tools, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes Experience with Ping Identity products and architectures, such as PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, PingOne, or PingID. Experience with identity governance, privileged access, customer identity, or workforce identity use cases beyond a single IAM product or deployment pattern. Familiarity with observability and operational tooling, such as centralised logging, monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing. Experience with source control, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and automated testing for repeatable IAM deployments. Experience migrating identity services, applications, or user populations from legacy platforms to modern IAM architectures. Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. Regular company and team bonding events. Competitive benefits and perks. Global volunteering and community initiatives Our Benefits: Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule Parental Leave Progressive Healthcare Options Retirement Programs Opportunity for Education Reimbursement Commuter Offset (Specific locations) Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. data.title: Product Manager, Pricing
data.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience. This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. About the Team Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users. The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics. Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth? What You'll Do Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products. Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability. Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X. Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities. Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy. Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics. Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash. What We're Looking For You might be a great fit if you: Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products. Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions. Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems. Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps. Can operate as a "conductor" — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo and Wolt, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. ➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog . We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here . Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. data.title: Senior Product Engineer
data.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. About the role Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up. You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them. You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build. What you’ll be doing Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production. Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it. Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight. Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control. Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship. Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it. Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you. What you’ll need to have done Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language. Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years. Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end. A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket. Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each. Genuine appetite for problems with no known answer, and comfort working without a precedent to copy. Confident, responsible use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output. Receptiveness to feedback. We give it directly and often, and we expect you to give it back. Helpful, not required Experience in insurance, underwriting, or another complex regulated domain. We will teach you the domain. We cannot teach curiosity about it. Experience across both backend and frontend. Experience building workflow, decision-support, or agent-assisted products. Experience working directly with enterprise clients. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Our commitment to Diversity hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. data.description: Unleash AI Innovators, Securely Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it. Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust. Our Opportunity: Runtime Foundation owns the shared cloud foundations that every Snyk service runs on: production Kubernetes clusters, ingress and service mesh, infrastructure provisioning and access, cluster upgrades, reliability and disaster recovery, and our AWS and GCP core services. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for this platform, lead our most ambiguous and consequential infrastructure work, and act as a trusted technical authority for teams across Snyk that depend on us. You’ll spend your time: Setting technical strategy for the platform, shaping the roadmap with engineering and product leadership, and making the case for investment in reliability, resilience and cost. Leading cross-team, org-level infrastructure initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and alignment through to production rollout and adoption. Acting as a technical authority for engineering teams across Snyk, setting infrastructure design standards, reviewing significant proposals, and influencing how teams build securely and reliably on our platform. Driving architectural direction for Kubernetes at scale, including cluster and node upgrade strategy, and leading diagnosis of deep networking, scheduling and resource-pressure issues in high-severity incidents. Defining the architecture for in-cluster platform services (ingress controllers, cert-manager, autoscaling components) and the Helm chart standards the wider organisation builds on. Shaping Terraform module architecture at organisational scale, including how state, drift and change safety are managed across a large multi-cloud estate. Making multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) architecture decisions with long-term consequences, including IAM, networking and managed-service resilience. Owning ingress, networking and service mesh architecture, including TLS, rate limiting and multi-tenant traffic design. Raising the engineering bar across the department: improving observability and operational practices, eliminating classes of toil systemically, and growing senior engineers through mentoring, sponsorship and example. You should apply if you: Have extensive professional experience (typically 5+ years) operating and architecting production infrastructure at scale, with a track record of leading work at organisation level rather than team level. Have deep, hands-on expertise across Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm and multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, and have led large, multi-team migrations or platform redesigns that shipped and stuck. Can take an ambiguous, cross-organisational problem, define what success looks like, build alignment across teams without formal authority, and communicate trade-offs clearly to engineers, directors and executive stakeholders. Have a history of making durable architectural decisions, and of knowing when to say no, when to defer and when to change course. Have mentored and sponsored senior engineers, and have measurably raised the technical bar of a team or department. Are comfortable being the go-to technical authority for other teams, and for leadership during significant incidents and risk discussions. Treat clear documentation (design docs, ADRs, runbooks) and automated testing as core to sustainable engineering, and set the example for others. We’d especially love to hear from you if you: Have designed or operated Teleport, RBAC, or JIT/least-privilege access systems at scale. Have driven cloud cost optimisation outcomes, including tools like PerfectScale, and tied them to business impact. Have built reusable CI/CD platform abstractions (CircleCI orbs, GHA reusable workflows, or similar) and driven org-wide adoption. Have led disaster-recovery strategy, backup validation and recovery automation across Kubernetes and cloud services, including DR exercises with cross-team participation.
