data.title: Software Engineer - Core Video & Data
data.description: At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces . We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more. Ready to join us? We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our Core Data team in London. This team builds the systems that power how Hudl understands sport at scale. From identifying players and teams across thousands of leagues to processing the moments that become highlights, stats and analysis, our services sit at the centre of Hudl’s platform. You’ll work on the Global Sports Library (GSL), the backbone that connects identities, metadata and game context across Hudl products. That means designing APIs, distributed services and large-scale data pipelines that help ensure every product at Hudl is operating from the same understanding of the game. The work is backend-heavy and deeply technical: data modeling, entity resolution, ingestion pipelines, consistency challenges, scalability and platform design. The systems you build won’t just support one product or one sport, they’ll become shared capabilities used across the company. As a Software Engineer, you’ll: Collaborate across disciplines. You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers, quality analysts, product managers and designers to build foundational data tools for the best of the best in sports. Deliver backend-heavy features. Your team has the autonomy to build and maintain the GSL, ensuring market teams have access to reliable, comprehensive data infrastructure. We iterate rapidly and deploy changes to our products hundreds of times a day. Propose new solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges within the Core Data domain and provide guidance to less experienced engineers. Thrive on the front lines. You’ll build pipelines and libraries that power every feature delivered to coaches and athletes, getting firsthand experience with how our data impacts the game. Location Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. Must-Haves Strong technical proficiency. You have at least three years of experience in engineering, specifically within backend-heavy or data-heavy environments. Cloud experience. You’ve spent time working with cloud-based systems and services and are a strong advocate for TDD and CI/CD. Experience navigating uncertainty. You’re comfortable taking on ambiguous work with many possible implementation options and identifying the one that pragmatically balances quality and immediate customer value. A collaborative, team-first mindset. You understand that building great software is a team effort and you’re always willing to pitch in or provide quality feedback in code reviews. Curiosity. You enjoy picking up new technologies and domains on the job. The idea of working across foundational layers of our stack and multiple products energizes you. Nice-to-Haves Tech stack knowledge. Professional background in C#, GraphQL, Elastic, MongoDB and AWS is ideal. Data infrastructure background. Experience working in environments with significant data scale and complex infrastructure needs. Familiarity with hybrid teams. You’ve worked with hybrid or remote teams before and can adapt quickly to our international working environment. Our Role Champion work-life harmony . We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Guarantee autonomy . We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas. Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing. Provide an environment to help you succeed . We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work. Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health. Compensation The base salary range for this role is displayed below— starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range. We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. data.title: Solutions Engineer - Warehouse Automation
data.description: About THG Ingenuity THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities. THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. About THG Fulfil THG Fulfil is part of THG Ingenuity, providing integrated warehousing, fulfilment and courier management solutions for leading e-commerce brands and enterprise businesses worldwide. Combining advanced warehouse automation with proprietary technology, we help brands scale their operations, improve efficiency and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our capabilities include AutoStore, Libiao and Geek+ robotics, supported by our own WMS/WCS/OMS platforms. About the Role As a Solutions Engineer , you will design innovative, scalable and commercially viable warehouse and fulfilment solutions for THG Fulfil’s enterprise clients. Working closely with customers, commercial teams, operations, engineering and technology specialists, you will translate complex operational requirements into practical warehouse designs that optimise capacity, throughput, productivity and cost efficiency. You will develop end-to-end solutions incorporating warehouse layouts, material flows, storage strategies, automation technologies and systems integration. The role will support both third-party automation opportunities and wider 3PL proposals, including the transition of enterprise customers into THG Fulfil facilities. Key Responsibilities Warehouse Solution Design Design end-to-end warehouse and fulfilment solutions for complex enterprise customers, from initial concept through to detailed proposals. Develop warehouse layouts, storage strategies, material flows, picking methodologies and operational processes. Evaluate and incorporate automation technologies, including AutoStore, Libiao and Geek+ robotics, based on customer requirements. Assess capacity, throughput, labour requirements and operational constraints to ensure solutions are scalable and deliverable. Customer Engagement & Requirements Work with enterprise customers to understand operational requirements, order profiles, volumes, growth plans and service-level expectations. Lead site visits, operational assessments and discovery workshops to gather requirements and identify opportunities for improvement. Translate customer needs into clear technical specifications and tailored fulfilment solutions. Modelling & Commercial Analysis Develop capacity plans, throughput models and operational resource requirements using customer data. Support solution simulations, cost modelling and ROI analysis to demonstrate the benefits of proposed solutions. Work with commercial teams to ensure designs are technically feasible, cost-effective and commercially viable. Proposals & Cross-Functional Collaboration Produce technical solution proposals incorporating warehouse layouts, process flows, automation configurations and supporting financial analysis. Present solutions to customer stakeholders and support tenders, RFPs and complex sales processes. Collaborate with operations, engineering, software and implementation teams to validate designs and ensure successful delivery. Define integration requirements across THG Fulfil’s WMS/WCS/OMS platforms and automated warehouse equipment. Skills & Experience Required Proven experience in warehouse solutions design, logistics engineering, intralogistics, automation engineering or supply chain solutions. Experience designing warehouse or fulfilment solutions for large-scale or complex operations. Strong understanding of warehouse processes, including storage, replenishment, picking, packing, sortation and dispatch. Knowledge of warehouse automation, including robotics, automated storage and retrieval systems, conveyors or goods-to-person solutions. Experience with warehouse layouts, capacity planning, throughput modelling and operational analysis. Commercial awareness, including experience supporting cost models, ROI calculations and customer proposals. Understanding of WMS, WCS and OMS platforms and their integration with warehouse automation. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions clearly to technical and commercial stakeholders. Desirable: Experience within 3PL, contract logistics or e-commerce fulfilment, with exposure to AutoStore, Libiao, Geek+ or warehouse design and simulation tools. THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability. THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community. Own performance against agreed client KPIs and targets - identifying risks and opportunities early and leading the optimisation plan to close any gaps. Turn data into insight, delivering clear, commercially focused reporting and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Use testing and learning to continuously improve shop performance, content effectiveness and creator ROI. Highly data-literate, with the ability to analyse performance, draw out insight and turn it into clear actions. Experience leading or mentoring others, and directing cross-functional teams to deliver to a high standard. data.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context This role is open to support an ambitious hiring goal: growing the team by 50%. You will join a team of three recruiters, alongside Léa, our Talent Lead, with whom you will work hand in hand. The priority of the role is hiring tech profiles: Senior Fullstack Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Engineers. Your missions Hire the best tech talent Gather hiring needs with Hiring Managers, co-build scorecards, then write and publish job offers. Source active and passive candidates through multiple channels, with a strong focus on headhunting (LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, events). Assess candidates and run hiring processes end to end in Ashby, through to the offer. Ensure a high-quality candidate experience at every step. Support Hiring Managers Be their point of contact and help them define their team strategy through hiring. Contribute to the recruiting team Contribute, alongside Léa, to improving our hiring processes and our employer brand. You you are : 2 to 4 years of experience in recruiting. Solid headhunting experience, especially on tech profiles, ideally gained in a SaaS company with a strong tech component. In-house recruiting experience is preferred. A sales mindset and the drive to win. Strong rigor, including in writing. Ideally, a good level of English. Hiring process A first call with Léa, Talent Lead (30 min) Interviews at our Paris office Reference checks Offer Why should you join us? Concrete impact: every hire directly contributes to Parallel’s growth. A structuring role: you help build our hiring processes and our employer brand. Competitive compensation: salary and equity (BSPCE). A great place to work: a bright office in Paris, regular team moments and two offsites a year. Flexibility: on average one day of remote work per week, and one remote week per year. Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, meal vouchers, public transport support, learning and wellbeing allowances. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Deployment Strategist
data.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context Parallel is an AI-powered platform that helps hospitals code medical acts faster and more accurately. We're a small, fast-moving team building a product that's already live in hospitals — and we're scaling. Until now, the Operations team has been handling everything: client onboarding, customer success, internal process building, and analytics. We're growing fast, and we need someone who can take full ownership of a client portfolio and help us structure our ops for the next stage. Your mission As our new Ops, you'll work hand in hand with Clémentine (Operations Manager) to deliver a best-in-class experience to our hospital clients and internal coders — from day one of onboarding to long-term success. You'll also contribute to building the operational backbone that lets Parallel scale without losing quality. Concretely, you will : Own the onboarding and follow-up of a portfolio of 30+ clients (hospitals and internal coders), ensuring smooth adoption and top-tier support Build and maintain scalable CS processes, tools and routines to monitor client satisfaction and usage Leverage data to identify bottlenecks and opportunities across client workflows and internal coding operations Act as the key link between clients and our Product & Tech teams — translating field insights into actionable priorities Outcomes At 6 months, you will have : Independently managed a portfolio of clients end-to-end, with no escalation needed for standard situations Deployed and trained new clients without Clémentine's direct involvement Identified and implemented 1 to 2 process improvements on internal ops (tracking, dashboards, workflows) Established yourself as a trusted point of contact for both clients and internal teams You are : Autonomous and structured. You manage your workload without being told what to do next. You build your own tracking systems, follow up proactively, and close loops without being reminded. Hands-on and pragmatic. You'd rather ship an imperfect solution and iterate than wait for the perfect framework. You figure things out. Analytically sharp. You don't rely on gut feel alone — you look at the data, spot patterns, and propose concrete actions. A strong communicator in French. You've dealt with clients before. You know how to adapt your tone whether you're talking to a hospital DG or a medical coder, without changing your substance. Genuinely curious about product, AI, or healthcare — or all three. This job is for you if : You have 2–4 years of experience in a startup, consulting firm, or project management role You've managed client relationships directly — and you're comfortable being the face of a company You thrive when there's no playbook yet and see that as an opportunity, not a problem You want to join a small team at a pivotal moment and have a real impact on how we operate Hiring process Quick call with Wallerand (talent) Call with Clémentine, Operations Manager Case study in our Paris office (with Paul & Clémentine) Final meeting with Paul, CEO Fast, no fluff. We'll give you clear feedback at every step. Why should you join us ? You'll work on a product that's already live and used daily in French hospitals — real impact, fast You'll have full ownership from day one — no micro-management, no hand-holding You'll be embedded in a tight-knit team where your work is visible and your voice matters You'll learn across ops, analytics, product and client management simultaneously Clear path to Lead Ops at 24 months as we structure the team into verticals Flexibility: on average one day of remote work per week, and one remote week per year We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. data.title: Pentester confirmé - Red Team
data.description: Ballpoint est une société de cybersécurité offensive spécialisée dans les tests d'intrusion, les audits de sécurité, les exercices de red team et la formation continue. Nous innovons également avec Trapster, notre solution de honeypot conçue pour améliorer la détection d'intrusion au sein des entreprises. Nous sommes une équipe de 7 passionnés, avec une forte culture technique, et nous collaborons avec une clientèle variée, du secteur public aux PME en passant par les SOC et MSSP. Le télétravail est possible régulièrement, mais ce poste demande une présence à Paris. Vos missions Vous travaillerez au cœur de l'équipe pentest pour réaliser des audits, évaluer les vulnérabilités et améliorer la posture de sécurité de nos clients, tout en prenant progressivement la main sur la structuration et la croissance de l'activité. Concrètement : Réaliser des audits de sécurité et tests d'intrusion (Web, Active Directory, Mobile, IoT…) Participer aux exercices Red Team (contournement EDR, spear-phishing, infra, intrusion physique…) Développer et utiliser des outils de pentest personnalisés Participer à l'élaboration de formations et de sensibilisations Contribuer à la rédaction d'articles techniques Et, à mesure que vous montez en responsabilité : Structurer et faire grandir la practice pentest (méthodologie, outillage, qualité des livrables) Encadrer et former les profils juniors (stagiaires, futurs recrutements) Participer aux choix techniques de l'équipe et à l'évolution de notre offre Être force de proposition sur la direction technique de Ballpoint Le périmètre s'ajuste selon votre profil et vos ambitions : plus vous voulez prendre, plus il y a à prendre. Vos compétences Vous avez déjà une expérience solide en pentest et : Maîtrise des outils de pentest et de leurs limites Usage courant des outils IA (automatisation, scripting, agents…) Aisance avec le scripting ou la programmation (Python, Bash, PowerShell…) Bonne connaissance des vulnérabilités courantes (injection SQL, XSS, CSRF, dépassement de tampon, etc.) et des concepts réseau/systèmes Fort intérêt pour la sécurité offensive et la veille technologique Autonomie, esprit d'équipe, capacité à prendre des initiatives et envie de faire grandir une structure Anglais courant (rédaction de rapports, veille internationale) Une appétence ou une première expérience d'encadrement est un vrai plus. Avantages Vous profiterez d'une vraie liberté d'action et de responsabilités dès votre arrivée. Ici, votre avis compte vraiment sur nos projets et nos méthodes. Vous travaillerez sur des missions variées, ce qui garantit que vous ne vous ennuierez jamais. Un package de rémunération qui dépasse le cadre du fixe : nous croyons à un alignement d'intérêts fort entre l'équipe et la croissance de Ballpoint, et nous en discutons ouvertement avec les bons profils. Processus de recrutement Un call de prise de contact pour comprendre votre candidature et présenter l'entreprise, le poste et nos attentes Un test technique avec rédaction d'un rapport de pentest, pour évaluer votre capacité à analyser et synthétiser Un entretien dans nos locaux pour mieux faire connaissance Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
data.description: À propos de Brixio Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. La mission L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans. Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe. Responsabilités Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration). Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security. Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs. Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client. OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques. Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA). Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca. Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One. Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants. Requirements Profil indispensable Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue. SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE. Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels. Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu. Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta. Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture. Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire. Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale). Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe. Atouts Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée). Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python. Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels. Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA. Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers). Évolution et ce que Brixio offre Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio. Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps). Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge. Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international. Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans. Processus de recrutement Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA). data.title: Consultant IT Strategy / CIO Office (H/F)
data.description: Description de l'entreprise Tech Riders est un cabinet de conseil qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs enjeux SI en proposant des services d’excellence sur deux domaines essentiellement : Conseil à la DSI (Gouvernance, Optimisation des Processus, Gestion des risques et Audit informatique etc.), Accompagnement Projet (Chefferie de projet, Product Management, Business Analyse, Développement, etc.). Nous croyons fermement que l'épanouissement professionnel est intimement lié à un équilibre sain entre la vie professionnelle et personnelle, une évolution de carrière fluide grâce à l'acquisition de nouvelles expertises, ainsi qu'une rémunération équitable. Conscients des priorités et attentes de nos collaborateurs, nous nous engageons à construire une entreprise à taille humaine, fondée sur des valeurs et des principes solides tels que la cohésion d'équipe, la transparence, l'équilibre de vie, et le partage de connaissances et de prospérité. Vos missions IT Strategy / Définition et déclinaison de la stratégie IT Au sein d'un environnement CIO Office, vous accompagnerez le management IT dans la définition, la structuration et la formalisation de sa stratégie IT. Vous serez notamment en charge de : Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie IT , en assurant son alignement avec les enjeux métiers, technologiques et les orientations du Groupe ; Analyser l'existant (As-Is) et définir une vision cible (To-Be) , en identifiant les axes de transformation et les opportunités d'optimisation ; Structurer les piliers stratégiques IT et les décliner en initiatives, trajectoires de transformation et roadmaps ; Conduire des analyses stratégiques transverses : architecture, Data & IA, cybersécurité, infrastructure, operating model, sourcing et delivery ; Challenger les orientations techniques, fonctionnelles et organisationnelles des différentes parties prenantes ; Préparer et animer des workshops stratégiques avec les responsables IT, les métiers et les experts ; Identifier les risques, dépendances et arbitrages , et formuler des recommandations argumentées à destination du management. CIO Office / Communication exécutive & Gouvernance Vous interviendrez également directement auprès du Top Management afin de : Concevoir des présentations PowerPoint de très haut niveau , destinées aux CIO, Heads of IT et instances de direction ; Transformer des sujets complexes en messages stratégiques clairs, synthétiques et impactants ; Préparer les instances de gouvernance : Steering Committees, Executive Reviews et workshops de direction ; Contribuer aux échanges avec le Top Management , en présentant, argumentant et défendant les orientations proposées ; Assurer la revue critique des livrables stratégiques , aussi bien sur le fond (analyses, cohérence, recommandations) que sur la forme (storytelling, qualité visuelle) ; Produire des synthèses exécutives et supports d'aide à la décision , facilitant les arbitrages du management ; Contribuer au suivi de la déclinaison opérationnelle de la stratégie IT. Vos compétences Outils et environnement PowerPoint — maîtrise avancée indispensable : présentations exécutives, storytelling stratégique, visualisation de données et qualité graphique ; Excel et Word : analyses, business cases et notes stratégiques ; Outils collaboratifs : Teams, SharePoint, Confluence, Jira ; Bonne connaissance des frameworks IT Strategy, IT Governance, Target Operating Model (TOM) et IT Roadmap ; Culture IT transverse : Cloud, Data & IA, cybersécurité, architecture SI, infrastructure et IT Operations . Description du profil Le profil recherché dispose idéalement des compétences suivantes : Expérience confirmée en IT Strategy, CIO Advisory, CIO Office ou conseil en transformation IT ; Excellente capacité d'analyse, de structuration et de synthèse , avec une véritable hauteur de vue stratégique ; Esprit critique et capacité à challenger des sujets techniques, fonctionnels et organisationnels ; Excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint , avec la capacité à produire des supports exécutifs dignes d'un cabinet de conseil en stratégie ; Communication orale et écrite irréprochable , avec une réelle aisance face au Top Management ; Très bonne compréhension des enjeux IT et métiers , permettant de dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs variés ; Capacité à structurer une réflexion, défendre des recommandations et faciliter les prises de décision ; Autonomie, proactivité, rigueur et exigence élevée sur la qualité des livrables ; Excellent niveau de français et d'anglais , à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Une expérience en cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou transformation IT constitue un véritable atout. Rejoignez la famille Tech Riders et devenez les Leaders de demain ! Découvrez un environnement où l'excellence, la qualité et l'humanité sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Business Development Representative
data.description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization. What you'll do Drive qualified pipeline generation Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition Own the qualification and handoff process Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team Experiment and optimize the sales motion Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates Be a Dust power user Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. Aptitude 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets Attitude Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better Agency Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Compensation: €45K – €65K BDR Full Comp - FR • €45K – €65K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.description: Assembleur et distributeur de dispositifs de perfusion et de nutrition entérale, IMM France (International Medical Mediation) est une PME française de référence sur son marché et située à Belfort (90). Depuis 30 ans, IMM France est aux côtés des professionnels de santé et leur proposons des dispositifs médicaux répondant aux plus hauts standards d’exigence. Présent sur la prise en charge des patients à domicile et en milieu hospitalier, nous développons des dispositifs permettant de réaliser antibiothérapie, hydratation ou chimiothérapie à domicile, le patient conservant ainsi une qualité de vie optimale. Vous maîtrisez les normes MDR et ISO 13485. Vous aspirez à intégrer une structure à taille humaine capable de vous impliquer dans un projet de développement ambitieux. Vous êtes force de proposition et appréciez le travail en équipe. Organisé, rigoureux et méthodique, vous savez évoluer dans un environnement réglementaire exigeant. data.title: Head of Sales – France & International
data.description: À propos de Galénic Fondée en 1978 par Pierre Fabre, Galénic est une Maison française de skincare scientifique qui associe excellence de la recherche, innovation et savoir-faire du luxe français. Portée par son centre d'innovation scientifique à Toulouse et par l'ouverture de la Maison Galénic Paris, à quelques pas de la Place Vendôme, la marque entre dans une nouvelle phase de développement. Notre ambition est de construire un modèle de distribution sélectif, international et omnicanal, conjuguant e-commerce, retail expérientiel, distributeurs premium et partenariats stratégiques. Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous recrutons notre futur Head of Sales & Retail– Europe & International. Votre mission Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Générale, vous aurez la responsabilité de construire, piloter et accélérer le développement commercial de Galénic en Europe et sur ses marchés internationaux prioritaires. Vous serez responsable de la performance commerciale, de la croissance du chiffre d'affaires et de la rentabilité de nos différents canaux de distribution. Vous interviendrez à la fois sur la définition des stratégies commerciales, leur exécution opérationnelle et la structuration progressive des équipes. Votre objectif : transformer l'ambition internationale de Galénic en un business durable, rentable et scalable. Vos responsabilités Piloter la stratégie et la performance commerciale Construire et déployer la stratégie commerciale à trois ans, en cohérence avec les ambitions de la marque. Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires, de rentabilité et de développement pour chaque canal. Piloter les budgets commerciaux, business plans, forecasts et P&L par canal. Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés : Net Sales, marge, productivité, conversion, sell-in et sell-out. Identifier les opportunités de croissance et optimiser les investissements commerciaux. 2. Accélérer le développement du e-commerce DTC Piloter la performance commerciale du e-commerce en collaboration avec les équipes Digital et Marketing. Développer le chiffre d'affaires, le taux de conversion, le panier moyen et la fidélisation client. Suivre la rentabilité du canal, les coûts d'acquisition et la contribution commerciale des investissements marketing. Développer une approche commerciale fondée sur la connaissance client, les données et la performance. 3. Développer la performance de la Maison Galénic Paris Accompagner le développement commercial de notre Maison, véritable flagship expérientiel de la marque. Piloter les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des soins et des ventes retail. Optimiser les réservations, le taux d'occupation des cabines, la conversion post-soin et la productivité commerciale. Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en préservant l'excellence de l'expérience client. 4. Construire et développer notre réseau de distribution international Définir et déployer les plans de développement commercial sur les marchés prioritaires Identifier, sélectionner et négocier avec les distributeurs et partenaires locaux. Construire les business plans par marché : objectifs commerciaux, conditions de distribution, investissements, marges et rentabilité. Piloter les relations avec les partenaires, leurs engagements commerciaux et leurs performances. Accompagner les lancements et le développement progressif de nouveaux marchés. 5. Développer les partenariats stratégiques Structurer un réseau sélectif de partenaires auprès des hôtels de luxe, palaces, spas, cliniques esthétiques, clubs privés et acteurs du luxe. Identifier et développer les opportunités commerciales à forte valeur ajoutée. Construire des modèles de partenariat rentables et pérennes. Piloter la contribution de ces partenariats au développement commercial et à la visibilité de Galénic. 6. Construire et animer l'organisation commerciale Structurer progressivement les équipes commerciales, en fonction du développement de l'activité. Manager et accompagner les responsables opérationnels et commerciaux. Développer une culture de performance, de responsabilité et d'excellence commerciale. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Global & Regional Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain et les partenaires internationaux. Profil recherché 10 à 15 ans dans la beauté, dont une expérience significative en distribution internationale et une exposition réelle au e-commerce et au retail. Expérience confirmée de direction commerciale ou de business development senior dans l'univers du skincare premium, de la beauté sélective ou du luxe. Expérience significative du développement international, notamment à travers des réseaux de distributeurs. Très bonne compréhension des enjeux du e-commerce DTC et de la distribution physique premium. Expérience dans la construction et le pilotage de business plans, budgets et P&L. Capacité démontrée à développer de nouveaux marchés, négocier des accords commerciaux et structurer des équipes. Forte sensibilité à l'univers du luxe, à l'expérience client et à la valeur de marque. Profil entrepreneurial, pragmatique, autonome et orienté résultats. Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement international, interculturel et en transformation. Anglais courant indispensable. Ce que nous offrons Un rôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation et du développement international d'une Maison française de skincare scientifique. L'opportunité de construire une organisation commerciale multicanale, avec une véritable responsabilité sur la croissance et la rentabilité. Une collaboration directe avec la Direction Générale et la Direction Marketing Un environnement entrepreneurial combinant héritage français, innovation scientifique et ambition internationale. Une rémunération attractive. Localisation : Paris, avec déplacements à l'international. Rattachement : Direction Générale Galénic Europe. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Product owner
data.description: From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats. We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year. Development and Delivery : work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ; You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory. data.title: RF Test & Validation Engineer
data.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As RF Test & Validation Engineer, you own the characterization and validation of Harmattan’s in-house radio, from boards to integrated systems. You take RF measurement work off the designers’ plate and turn it into a repeatable, automated discipline: setups, measurements, and clear results fed back to the design team. You also keep the RF lab in working order as test capacity grows. You work primarily within the Radio team, with occasional exposure to other RF-based teams. Responsibilities Run RF characterization and validation of radio boards and integrated radio systems. Build and maintain automated RF test benches, including interconnects, harnesses, and fixtures. Develop reusable Python suites for instrument control and data capture across standard RF measurements. Perform pre-compliance and compliance-support measurements, including EMC and thermal testing. Test antennas, both standalone and integrated on systems. Support the integration of the radio on our systems. Analyze results, flag anomalies, and deliver clear, structured reports to RF designers. Own the RF lab: track calibration, manage fixtures and accessories, and identify equipment gaps. Support team members who are less experienced in RF testing. Candidate Requirements Hands-on experience running RF characterization with VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, power meter, AWG, and oscilloscope. Solid grasp of standard measurements such as S-parameters, P1dB, IIP3, sensitivity, and spurious. Experience building reusable test automation, Python preferred. Skilled in fine-pitch SMD and coaxial-cable rework on RF boards. Careful around input-power damage thresholds, protecting both instruments and devices under test. Rigorous and perceptive: interprets results before reporting and spots anomalies early. Writes clear, structured reports. Keeps a shared lab tidy and works well alongside designers. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Head of Client Service & Customer Operations
data.description: Weezevent propose des solutions aux organisateurs d’événements , afin de garantir une expérience unique aux utilisateurs . Leader français de la billetterie en ligne et leader européen du paiement cashless , nous proposons une suite complète de solutions incluant également contrôle d'accès , CRM et de gestion d'équipe . Des festivals emblématiques tels que Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK et Boomtown aux grands événements sportifs comme le Grand Prix de Mexico ou les Jeux Olympiques et Paralympiques de Paris 2024, Weezevent accompagne des événements de toutes tailles et de tous formats. Fondé en 2008, Weezevent a reçu le prix européen Fast 500 de l'innovation en 2014 et a figuré dans le classement French Tech Next40 en 2024 et 2025. Aujourd'hui, nous employons plus de 200 personnes en France, au Royaume-Uni, en Espagne, en Suisse, en Allemagne, aux Pays-Bas, en Belgique, au Portugal et au Canada, et déployons nos solutions lors d'environ 1 000 événements majeurs chaque année. Vous supervisez le portefeuille clients B2B Self-Service (10M€ de CA) ainsi que le support B2C délégué sur les grands événements européens. Votre objectif : garantir une qualité de service irréprochable, maximiser la satisfaction client et développer le revenu du segment Self-Service tout en animant les équipes support internationales. Management & pilotage des canaux de contact (phoning, mailing, chats, bots, whatsapp..) Dimensionner les équipes, organiser les plannings et suivre la charge de travail selon les flux entrants, à hauteur de 200k+ demandes écrites et 30k+ appels téléphoniques entrants annuels. Garantir l'atteinte des SLAs opérationnels sur le téléphone (taux de décroché, temps d'attente, DMC) et le ticketing/email (délai de réponse, résolution au premier contact). Mettre en place la charte de communication, les scripts et effectuer le contrôle qualité ( Quality Monitoring ). Gestion des avis, e-réputation & réseaux sociaux Co-piloter la stratégie de branding de la marque au niveau européen avec le marketing. Faire évoluer la note globale et l'image de marque sur les plateformes clés (Trustpilot, Google, Avis Vérifiés, etc.) à travers des campagnes ciblées. Gérer la modération, traiter les avis négatifs sous des délais stricts et automatiser la collecte d'avis positifs pour atteindre les objectifs. Gestion du segment Self-Service & expérience Client En charge d’un périmètre de 10M€ de CA pour 40.000 clients self-service B2B. Responsable des supports B2C délégués, spécifiques aux clients Grands Comptes / Top100 clients. Superviser le cycle de vie complet (billetterie, contrôle d’accès, CRM & Staff management) : onboarding, accompagnement, support, résolution de problèmes et optimisation de leur satisfaction. Identifier les opportunités d'upsell et optimiser le revenu généré par ce segment. Mesurer et analyser en continu les indicateurs de satisfaction (NPS, CSAT, CES). Reporting mensuel au Board du Group et Country Managers des KPIs du département. Collaboration étroite avec les Product Owners et le département finance pour la résolution des problèmes et l’amélioration continue des services. Management d'équipe & amélioration continue Encadrer, manager, former et faire monter en compétences les 25 Client Service Advisor répartis dans 6 pays (France, Angleterre, Pays-Bas, Espagne, Allemagne et Belgique) ainsi qu’une dizaine de prestataires freelances locaux ou off-shore. Administrer les outils du service client (Intercom, Aircall, logiciels et produits Weezevent, plateformes d'avis, Google Sheet). Analyser les motifs de contact récurrents ( Voix du Client ) pour faire remonter les dysfonctionnements aux équipes Produit et Opérations. Implémentation de l’IA pour booster la performance et automatiser les tâches à moins forte valeur ajoutée. Profile sought Expérience : 7+ ans en gestion de service client / support client au niveau européen ou international, dont une expérience réussie en management d'équipe. Hard Skills Maîtrise des KPIs opérationnels d’un Service Client premium (Taux de décroché, SLA, DMC, CSAT, NPS, FCR). Connaissance des outils de relation client (Intercom, Aircall, HubSpot, Trustpilot, etc.). Capacité à piloter un segment client en autonomie (Self-service / Digital et d’en assurer la croissance. Une expérience dans le secteur de la billetterie et/ou de l’évènementiel est fortement appréciée Anglais courant Soft Skills : Leadership, sens aigu du service client, rigueur analytique, excellente communication orale et écrite, gestion des imprévus opérationnels. data.title: Senior Customer Care Manager
data.description: Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne. Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds. Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés. Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund. Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable. Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement) Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix) L'équipe Vous rejoignez l'équipe Customer Services composée de deux teams managées par Thibaut : Support Customer Care et Support L2. L'équipe Customer Care est composée actuellement de 4 personnes. Le rôle En tant que Senior Customer Care Manager , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la satisfaction et la fidélisation de nos clients. Avec un portefeuille composée des grandes comptes, vous serez chargé de fournir un support de haute qualité en répondant aux demandes clients, tout en prenant en charge la gestion opérationnelle pour nos clients. Vous interviendrez également sur des projets transversaux stratégiques, en lien avec les autres équipes métiers, pour contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus et services. Vos missions principales Gestion des demandes clients Prendre en charge les tickets entrants en assurant des réponses précises, rapides et de haute qualité. Répondre aux appels des clients sur une plage horaire définie, en assurant un traitement courtois, efficace et orienté solution. Escalader les demandes complexes aux équipes métiers concernées (Payments, Compliance, Produit, Support L2). Analyser les problématiques récurrentes pour identifier les axes d’amélioration et partager vos insights avec les équipes internes. Gestion des clients prioritaires Être le point de contact opérationnel pour certains de nos top clients , en coordonnant les réponses à leurs demandes et en assurant un traitement prioritaire. Organiser et animer des revues opérationnelles à la demande des clients afin d’assurer un suivi rigoureux de leurs besoins et de leurs attentes. Projets transversaux et expertise Contribuer à des projets internes stratégiques, tels que la mise à jour de la documentation ou l’optimisation des processus. Devenir référent(e) sur certains outils ou sujets spécifiques (Salesforce, Aircall/Ringover). Accompagner et coacher les membres juniors de l’équipe pour partager vos connaissances et renforcer l’expertise globale de l’équipe. Expérience et savoir-faire Vous avez au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Customer Care / Support / Success Vous avez une première expérience confirmée en fintech (paiements). Vous avez développé(e) à travers vos expériences un relationnel fort qui vous permet de gérer des comptes complexes avec des stakeholders stratégiques. Compétences techniques et relationnelles Maîtrise de Salesforce, et d’un outil de téléphonie tel qu’Aircall ou Ringover (indispensable). Une appétence pour les outils techniques et une capacité à analyser des données ou retours clients pour identifier des solutions. Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, avec une approche orientée client. La maîtrise de l’anglais et du français est indispensable. L’espagnol sera un gros plus. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un environnement dynamique et stimulant où vos idées comptent. La possibilité de travailler sur des projets d’envergure en collaboration avec des équipes transverses. Un équilibre vie pro/vie perso avec un poste basé à Paris avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine. Echange avec un membre de notre équipe pour mieux comprendre le rôle, l’équipe et notre culture. 4. Entretien avec notre VP Customer Success Lemonway s'engage à promouvoir la diversité, notamment en favorisant le mixité Femme/Homme et l'emploi de personne en situation de handicap. data.title: Senior Data Engineer
data.description: Job title: Senior Data Engineer Department: Data team Reports to: Lead Data Engineer Location: Paris, France Contract: Permanent, local and full-time Starting date: ASAP 2026 PUR Description PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. About the role As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python. Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets. Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications. Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy. Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster . Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure). Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions. Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices. We are looking for someone with: 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering , with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines. Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts. Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus). Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus). Strong knowledge of Git and software engineering best practices. Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills. Recruitment process : Interview with the recruiter Interview with the manager and case study References check At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique. PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment. data.description: Qui sommes-nous ? data.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Why Deliveroo (part of DoorDash) Deliveroo, part of the DoorDash group, is building the leading local commerce platform, connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers in real time. Paris is one of our most strategic and complex markets globally, with unmatched density, brand concentration, and competitive intensity. As we move towards our 2026 ambition , we are evolving our commercial organisation to match the scale and sophistication required to win in Paris. This includes increased seniority, clearer regional ownership, and stronger execution across Inner and Outer Paris. The Senior Client Partner – Paris Inner Ouest role is a newly strengthened position, designed to combine strategic partner leadership, regional ownership, and organisation building . The Role As a Senior Client Partner, you'll lead a team of Account Management Lead, Senior Account Manager and Account Manager and you will report to the Regional Director of Paris, part of the Commercial team. The position is based in Paris. You are accountable for the growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios across one of Paris' most critical zones. You will act as the senior commercial owner for your territory, ensuring alignment between Paris-wide strategy and local execution. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions . You will design, lead, and continuously evolve the account management setup to ensure the right level of seniority, coverage, and execution quality across the territory. This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development. Key Responsibilities 1. Lead Commercial Strategy & Execution Excellence Own the end-to-end growth of brand portfolios within your Paris Inner cluster Ensure 5★ account management standards across the team, with clear portfolio sizing Build and maintain relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell strategies Create and execute joint business plans addressing partner growth, profitability, and operational performance Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights on Deliveroo capabilities, competitors, and market trends Responsible for a commercial initiative for Paris : engage team, drive performance and proactively adjust structure, focus, or processes 2. Regional & Portfolio Ownership Own a zone cluster, defining and executing the strategy to win Translate Paris-wide and national priorities into clear, actionable regional strategies Improve Client Value Proposition (CVP) across the territory in collaboration with other commercial departments 3. Talent Development & Succession Lead and develop a team of up to 10 AMs / SAMs, either directly or through mid-management Coach and mentor high-potential talent, building a strong internal succession pipeline 4. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Finance Represent your portfolio and organisation in Paris and France leadership forums Influence roadmap and prioritisation through structured partner and market feedback What We're Looking For Experience 10+ years in commercial, client partnership, or account management roles Proven experience managing complex, strategic brand portfolios Demonstrated success leading multi-layered teams in fast-paced environments Experience in F&B, Hospitality, Retail, FMCG, or Marketplace businesses preferred Strong commercial and financial acumen (P&L understanding) Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills Ability to design and scale organisations and coverage models Data-driven, structured, and execution-focused Senior, credible, and resilient leader High ownership mindset with a bias for action Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving change Passionate about people development and raising standards Life at Deliveroo At Deliveroo, you'll work on some of the most complex and impactful challenges in local commerce. We move fast, value ownership, and believe that strong teams build great outcomes. This role offers significant scope, visibility, and influence in shaping how Deliveroo wins in Paris. data.title: Founding AI Engineer @Plato (backed by Hexa)
data.description: ⚖️ Who are we Plato is building the AI OS for litigation lawyers. With AI, the legal industry is on the verge of a major transformation. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more. Our mission: Build the leading AI OS for litigation lawyers , enabling professionals to work 5x faster , by putting their whole firm on autopilot. Plato already supports more than 30 law firms and 1 major insurance company’s legal team, who use our solution daily to manage hundreds of active cases. Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding. Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals. 🎯 Your mission You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product . Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems . You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs. Responsibilities Build AI-powered product features Design and ship AI features used directly by lawyers Be at the bleeing edge of the agentic stack: memory, sandboxes, code mode, lots of tools, subagents… Turn prototypes and experiments into production-ready feature Work with complex data Extract, structure and reason over large volumes of unstructured legal documents Build robust data and document-processing pipelines Experiment with different models and approaches to improve accuracy and reliability Make AI work in production Evaluate and improve agent outcomes through testing, evals and iteration Optimize systems for quality, latency and cost Build the backend services and infrastructure needed to run AI reliably at scale Shape the product Work directly with the founders and users to understand real-world problems Move quickly from problem → experiment → production (think days, not weeks) Take ownership of your projects from exploration to deployment 🤩 This role is for you if We're looking for a strong software or AI engineer with 2+ years of experience who wants to build real-world AI products at the forefront of the agentic stack. You like working close to founders and users, making pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping software that actually runs in production. data.title: Stage - Finance Operations Intern
data.description: En rejoignant l’équipe Finance de Matera, tu découvriras les coulisses financières d’une start-up et contribueras chaque jour au bon fonctionnement de ses opérations ! Remboursements clients, facturation, suivi de la trésorerie ou fiabilité des données : tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au contact de l’équipe et des demandes du quotidien. En tant que stagiaire FinOps , tu seras accompagné·e par Valent, Head of Finance, et Ryo, Team Lead Finance , pour apprendre progressivement à gérer les opérations financières. Au cœur de tes missions : le suivi et la résolution des tickets finance, de la réception de la demande jusqu’à sa clôture. Tes missions au sein de l’équipe Finance Formé·e dès ton arrivée, tu prendras progressivement en charge les missions suivantes : Gérer les tickets finance : traiter les demandes reçues sur Slack et Front : remboursements clients, factures manquantes, doublons de facturation ou demandes de plan de paiement. L’objectif collectif : ne laisser aucun ticket ouvert à la fin de la semaine ; Fiabiliser nos données : identifier et corriger les incohérences pour disposer de données financières fiables et à jour ; Participer aux opérations financières : contribuer à la facturation clients, au suivi de la trésorerie et au paiement des fournisseurs ; Contribuer au reporting : participer à la préparation des reportings et à la réalisation d’analyses simples pour accompagner le suivi de l’activité ; Découvrir d’autres sujets Finance : selon ta progression, participer aux échanges avec le cabinet comptable et les auditeurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de nos processus grâce aux outils no-code ou à l’IA. Ton parcours d’apprentissage Pas besoin de tout maîtriser avant de nous rejoindre : ce stage est justement là pour te permettre d’apprendre ! Un accompagnement dès le premier jour : tu découvriras nos outils, nos processus et les bons réflexes avec l’appui de Ryo ; Une montée en compétences progressive : tu apprendras à comprendre les demandes, à identifier les actions nécessaires et à suivre les sujets jusqu’à leur résolution ; Une découverte concrète de la finance en start-up : au fil de tes missions, tu te familiariseras avec notre business model SaaS et ses implications financières ; Une ouverture sur l’amélioration continue : tu pourras poser tes questions, partager tes idées et contribuer à la construction d’une jeune équipe en croissance. À la fin de ton stage, tu sauras gérer les tickets finance de bout en bout , tu auras acquis les bases du business model SaaS et tu auras découvert les principaux sujets financiers d’une start-up. Les avantages Gratification : 1 000 € par mois pour un stage de césure ou 1 200 € par mois pour un stage de fin d’études; Une montée en compétences concrète en opérations financières, avec un accompagnement au quotidien ; Une carte titres-restaurant Swile , prise en charge à 50 % ; Un accès à Gymlib pour faire du sport à petits prix ; Une prise en charge des transports à 50 % ; Une demi-journée de congé par mois ; Un ordinateur et les équipements nécessaires fournis. Informations pratiques Localisation : Paris Type de contrat : stage Durée : 6 mois Équipe : Finance Date de démarrage : dès que possible Profil recherché Idéalement, tu : Es étudiant·e en finance, gestion, comptabilité ou en école de commerce et recherches un stage de 6 mois ; Fais preuve de rigueur et d’organisation : tu aimes suivre tes sujets jusqu’au bout et ne pas laisser une demande en suspens ; Es curieux·se et n’hésites pas à poser des questions pour comprendre le fonctionnement d’un outil ou d’un processus ; As envie d’apprendre, de travailler en équipe et de contribuer à l’amélioration de nos façons de faire ; Parles couramment français et anglais . Aucune expérience préalable n’est requise : nous t’accompagnons dès le premier jour. Ce qui compte, c’est ton envie d’apprendre, ta fiabilité et ton intérêt pour les sujets financiers. data.title: Fullstack Engineer
data.description: Who we are Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies. The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience. Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you: €45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries The Role You'd join the engineering team to own features end to end, with a strong lean toward the interfaces and workflows clients interact with directly. This is a product engineering role. Unlike our Forward Deployed Engineers, you are not embedded with clients or responsible for running deployments in the field. You turn operational needs and field feedback into a durable core product. What this looks like in practice: Own end-to-end features on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from scoping and interaction choices through backend implementation and production Spend significant time on the front end, building clear, reliable workflows for users working with complex information under pressure Solve real geospatial problems: move data between backend and frontend through tile servers and use PostGIS for demanding spatial queries Build and harden ML and LLM workflow orchestration, including retries, queueing, and long-running jobs with LangGraph and LangChain Design for on-prem and appliance deployment, where hardware, connectivity, and resource constraints matter as much as cloud scalability Work closely with product, design, and forward-deployed teams to turn user signal into features that work across clients Who We're Looking For We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and first-principles problem solving. We want builders who can move across the stack while keeping the user-facing experience sharp. Must-have: Strong full-stack production experience, with genuine comfort owning both interfaces and backend systems Solid TypeScript and React, plus Python experience or the ability to become productive quickly with FastAPI A track record of taking features from an ambiguous problem through release and iteration Product judgement and attention to detail, especially in workflows used directly by customers Comfort deciding what to build now, what to make durable, and what to leave out EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts) Nice to have: Experience with PostGIS, GIS, mapping, or other geospatial systems Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or multi-step ML and LLM workflows Experience deploying software on-prem, offline, or as an appliance Experience with front-end performance and data-dense interfaces Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology What's In It For You Competitive package (top 0.1% of compensation in Europe: base + equity) Paris or London based End-to-end ownership of product used in real operational environments The Process Talent screening : 30 min, online. Background and motivation. Technical screening : 45min, online. Skills assessment. Onsite in Paris : half day (3 hours). System Design, Re-engineering and Project Presentation. Roundtable.
