data.title: Corporate Paralegal
data.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the Role Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally. This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible. What you'll do 1. Cap Table & Share Register Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential. 2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record. 3. Insurance & Document Management Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity. 4. Procurement Contracts First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work. What you bring 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups). Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40). Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates. Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally. Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration. Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH). Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms. Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding. Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus. data.title: Growth Marketer (m/f/d)
data.description: About Benetics AI People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type. More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits. About the role We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next. What we're looking for Campaign-oriented: Build campaigns around a real customer need, connecting audience, message and channels. High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video. Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign. Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social. Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel. Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round. Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful. AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters. Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale. Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change. Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site Experience 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through. Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus. Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful. Why Benetics AI A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work. Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns. Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work. How we hire Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call A practical case with the team. Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why. You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about a campaign, a piece of content or an AI workflow you built, what you changed and what happened. You don't need a cover letter. data.title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
data.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position Description We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine. Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving. We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure. What you will do Data Architecture & Engineering Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free. Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs. ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions. Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency. Technical Customization & Custom Development Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines. Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages. Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks. API & Ecosystem Integrations Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform. Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync. Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers. Platform Operations & System Health Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime. Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM). Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure. Experience and qualifications Core Technical Competencies Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning. Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman. Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech. MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization. Experience 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks). Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing. Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools. Key Personality Traits Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends. Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges. Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

data.title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
data.description: Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen. Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht. Über Dukers Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen. Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen. Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt. Deine Rolle Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson. Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online. Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig. Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit. Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein. Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt. Womit du arbeitest Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür. Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Führerausweis Kategorie B Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt. Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung. Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan. Was dich bei Dukers erwartet Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest. Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv. Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn. Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen. Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit. E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation. Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung. Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um. Lernen wir uns kennen Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne. Deine Ansprechpersonen: Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen. Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen. Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt. Dukers GmbH | St. Gallen Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

data.title: Autonomy Engineer Intern, Reinforcement Learning, 2027 (Zurich)
data.description: Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders , soldiers in battlefield scenarios , and beyond . About the role: Skydio builds the world’s most advanced autonomous drones used across inspection, public safety, defense, cinematography, and more. Your research won’t languish in a paper: it will fly , shaping how pilots and operators complete real missions in complex environments. Develop and deploy reinforcement learning (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft plan, navigate, and control themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows. How you'll make an impact: Navigation & avoidance in the wild: Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking. RL-augmented planning: Fuse learned cost shaping / value functions with trajectory optimization for smooth, agile flight with tight safety envelopes and mission constraints. Sim to Real at scale: Build scalable datasets and training loops with Isaac Lab, domain randomization, residual learning, and safety filters; validate on real drones weekly. Human-in-the-loop shared control: Learn assistive policies that blend pilot intent, autonomy priors, and uncertainty-aware behaviors for intuitive control handoffs. Fleet & multi-agent: Explore decentralized coordination for coverage, pursuit, and collaborative mapping with minimal comms. What makes this internship different: Real hardware cadence: Prototype in sim, then flight test on production-ready aircraft and edge compute. Your work is meant to make a difference in the real world, not just in simulation. Safety-first learning: We pair RL with formal constraints, estimation of uncertainty, and conservative action filters for dependable deployment in human environments. Cross-disciplinary mentorship: Collaborate with perception, mapping, controls, and product teams to close the loop from research to field ops. What makes you a strong fit: PhD student in Robotics, Machine Learning, Controls, or related field. Strong fundamentals in RL , control theory, and motion planning; comfort with safety/robustness concepts. Proficient in Python (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of C++ or CUDA. Hands-on experience with robotics simulation (Isaac Lab/MuJoCo/PyBullet) and sim2real techniques. Experience training/deploying policies for navigation, manipulation, or locomotion on real robots or autonomous vehicles. Nice-to-Haves: Publications (CoRL, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS). Experience with onboard inference optimization (TensorRT, quantization, sparsity). Familiarity with modern policy learning beyond vanilla RL: diffusion policies, IL/BC, offline RL, model-based RL. Experience with multi-agent RL or distributed training. Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Masters, and $70/hr for PhD students*. data.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. data.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
data.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The team At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves. The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint. About the role What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day. Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns. What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it. What you'll do Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds. Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default. Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast. Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI. Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own. Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling. Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships. Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability. We're excited about you because You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer , with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production. You have 2+ years of professional Go experience , writing services that run in production, not side projects. You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew. You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers. You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it. You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns. You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work. You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live. Strong plus Experience with distributed systems , Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure. Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC). Experience running multi-tenant systems. Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills. What you'll get Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them. Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily. Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership. Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Around each cohort Get every participant ready before they arrive, so the Academy starts with momentum on day one. Proven experience designing and delivering trainings, workshops, or customer onboarding sessions yourself, ideally to business or technical audiences. Experience with ERP systems or finance processes, workshop or event formats, or AI-driven SaaS is a plus. How You Grow As BLP grows, the Academy grows with it, and so does this role. You will be close to our clients, our experts and our leadership, which opens doors across the company as we expand. data.title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
data.description: Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite. Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours. Ce que vous ferez Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission. Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance. Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée. Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses. Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation. Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être. Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience : Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes. Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission. Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté. Ce que nous cherchons Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes. Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas. La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise. De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole. Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients. Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier. Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris. Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe. Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client. Ce que vous trouverez chez nous Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME. Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année. Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet. Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux. Comment nous recrutons Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape. 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions. 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter. 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés. Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape. Candidature Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

data.title: Critical Operations Technician - Switzerland
data.description: The Role As part of the local Critical Operations Team, Critical Operations Technicians (COT) ensure the data center is operating smoothly and efficiently 24/7/365, with no downtime of critical services. Critical Operations Technicians are responsible for the inspection, operation and maintenance of all equipment associated with the data center. They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round. Key Responsibilities Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned. Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards. Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions. Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized. Manage and react to emergency situations involving critical equipment, escalating incidents according to established processes and procedures. Ensure all plant equipment operates at maximum efficiency and in compliance with industry best practices and regulations. Escort personnel when required for security or operational reasons (e.g. clients and vendors). Ensure compliance with housekeeping rules, facility manuals, and service agreements, managing vendor reports and follow-ups. Maintain accurate logs of completed and pending work in the Facility Management System. Support the preparation of technical work quotations and execution of assigned projects and programs. Maintain proper storage of documentation related to building infrastructure, systems, and tools. Participate in ongoing training, development, and drills to stay updated in relevant disciplines. Ensure a proper handover of relevant information within the team as needed. Job Practicalities / Skills, Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications Preferably in possession of trade certificate and/or vocational education degree within Electrical or Mechanical discipline or equivalent. Preferably experienced with electrical or mechanical systems in a critical environment and/or within a data center. In-depth knowledge of various maintenance fundamentals to deal with service and repairs. Ability to perform a range of complex work activities with some degree of personal responsibility and autonomy. Ability to work alone or collaboratively in a team. Attention to detail while maintaining a broad perspective Desire and ability to learn new skills and systems. Effective interpersonal skills for collaboration with vendors and clients. IT and computer skills (MS Office suite) with ability to work in and learn various operating software tools and systems. Good written and verbal skills in English and local language (German/Scandinavian/French/Italian languages are a plus). Service-oriented mindset with a focus on client satisfaction. Preferred start date: November 2026. However, an earlier start date may be discussed and arranged depending on the candidate's availability. All applications will be treated confidentially. data.title: Principal / Senior Consultant EU Transport & Mobility (Project Delivery & Excellence)
data.description: Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research About Panteia Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations. Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States. Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments. As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence. The role To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence. This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy. The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners. Key responsibilities Project delivery & leadership Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements. Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination. Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners. Team & quality leadership Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners). Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables. Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes. Role in acquisition & transition The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals: Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals. Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage. Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution. Position in the organisation Reports to: Team manager. Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners. Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility. Practicalities Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model – Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week) – Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations. Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset. Start date: As soon as possible. Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks. Why join Panteia? Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience. Combine analytical depth with real policy impact. Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets. Work in a compact, expert-driven team. Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered. Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials. Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc. What Panteia is looking for: 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting. Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment. Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis. Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills. Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes. Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus. MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field. Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed. data.title: Senior Adviseur Energie En Laadinfrastructuur Goederenvervoer
data.description: Werken aan de energietransitie in transport. De transportsector staat voor een fundamentele verandering. Elektrificatie en de ontwikkeling van laadinfrastructuur zijn cruciaal voor de toekomst van het goederenvervoer. Panteia ondersteunt overheden, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven met onafhankelijk onderzoek en advies. Voor ons team Transport en Mobiliteit zoeken wij een senior adviseur die dit werkveld verder uitbouwt. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van energie, logistiek en beleid. Denk aan de ontwikkeling van laadpleinen, depotladen en de integratie van energie in logistieke systemen. Jij: leidt onderzoeks- en adviesprojecten van offerte tot oplevering; stuurt op kwaliteit, planning en budget van projecten; vertaalt beleidsvragen naar concrete onderzoeksopzetten en werkplannen; ontwikkelt nieuwe proposities rond laden en energie in transport; onderhoudt en bouwt relaties met opdrachtgevers zoals ministeries, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven; speelt een actieve rol in acquisitie en het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten; werkt samen met nationale en - waar relevant - Europese partners. Deze vacature daagt jou uit …om op strategisch niveau bij te dragen aan de oplossing van grote maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je richt je hierbij op een breed spectrum van goederenwegtransport tot energietransitie vraagstukken als gevolg van strengere klimaat- en energiedoelen. Binnen Panteia is Team Transport & Mobiliteit een onafhankelijke intermediair tussen de transportsector en beleidsmakers en richt zich bijvoorbeeld op onderzoek en advisering van de introductie van batterij elektrische voertuigen, laadinfra tot biobrandstoffen en bijbehorende complexe rekendossiers met forse maatschappelijke belangen en grote financiële gevolgen. Projecten van Panteia hebben vaak een omgeving met meerdere stakeholders en grote politieke aandacht. Panteia T&M biedt scherp inzicht op goederenwegvervoerbeleid en de daarbij behorende omgevingsfactoren, zodat opdrachtgevers verantwoorde beslissingen en beleidskeuzes kunnen maken. Wie die opdrachtgevers zijn? Denk aan lokale, regionale, nationale, en internationale overheden, en brancheorganisaties. Zij kunnen rekenen op gedegen en toepasbaar onderzoek en advies van Panteia. Aan afwisseling en uitdaging geen gebrek dus! Als onze nieuwe senior adviseur zit jij boven op de ontwikkelingen in de samenleving en weet je precies wat onze opdrachtgevers drijft en waar zij behoefte aan hebben. Wat breng je mee? Je combineert inhoudelijke kennis met gevoel voor de praktijk en weet hoe beleid, markt en techniek samenkomen. Jij: hebt ruime ervaring (minimaal 5 jaar) opgedaan met energie- en mobiliteitsvraagstukken; hebt kennis van laadinfrastructuur en/of aanverwante thema’s; kent de transport- en logistieke sector goed; hebt ervaring met het leiden van projecten; kunt zelfstandig opdrachten verwerven en uitbouwen; begrijpt beleidsprocessen en schakelt gemakkelijk met publieke en private partijen; bent een teamspeler die energie krijgt van samen resultaten behalen; werkt gestructureerd en bewaakt de kwaliteit van resultaten; communiceert helder en overtuigend; beschikt over een goede beheersing van de Nederlands en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau. Wat bieden wij? Je krijgt de ruimte om een groeiend en relevant thema verder vorm te geven binnen onze organisatie. Wij bieden: projecten met directe impact op beleid en praktijk in de transportsector; veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap; een compact en deskundig team van collega’s; goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden; goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder 22 vakantie – en 12 ATV-dagen; station Zoetermeer op 6 min. loopafstand en een NS kaart voor woon-werk verkeer en zakelijke reizen; een informele werksfeer met bevlogen collega’s en een actieve personeelsvereniging. een hybride werkomgeving met standplaats Zoetermeer. Je wordt onderdeel van een enthousiast team van transport- en mobiliteitsexperts die actief zijn in de Nederlandse en Europese markt. Jouw toekomstige collega’s staan midden in de samenleving en omschrijven zichzelf als professioneel, gedreven en met passie voor hun vak. Interesse? Enthousiast over deze vacature? data.title: HR Stagiaire
data.description: Draag bij aan onze missie Creating A Climate For Growth en word de nieuwe Stagiair(e) HR bij Priva! Ben jij enthousiast, leergierig en zelfstandig en op dit moment bezig met een opleiding in de richting van Human Resource Management? Dan zijn wij een match! Wat ga je doen? Als HR stagiair(e) bij Priva kom je terecht in een enthousiast HR team, bestaande uit HR Business Partners, Recruiters, HR Officers en een HR Assistant. We zijn een ambitieus team waarin we houden van hard werken, maar waar ook ruimte is voor een geintje of een goed gesprek. Tijdens jouw stage draai je volledig mee in het voorbijkomend HR werk en helpen wij je graag in het ontwikkelen van je competenties en de mogelijke schoolopdrachten. Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen. Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen. Wie ben jij? Wij zijn opzoek naar een enthousiaste derde- of vierdejaars stagiair die graag ervaring op wilt doen in HR. Bij voorkeur volg je de HBO-opleiding Human Resource Management, maar ook studenten van andere opleidingen waarbij HR een onderdeel is zijn welkom. Je bent proactief, nauwkeurig, communicatief vaardig en betrokken bij het team en je collega’s binnen Priva. Ook vind je het geen probleem om met internationale collega’s in het Engels te communiceren zowel schriftelijk als mondeling. Voor deze stage verwachten we dat je 24 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar bent. Wat je krijgt Een uitdagende stage waarin je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen en waardevolle praktijkervaring opdoet. Toegang tot onze gratis fitnessfaciliteiten op locatie, waar je kunt meedoen aan Crossfit-, Pilates-, Yoga- en Full Body Workout of speel een potje tafelvoetbal en tafeltennis mee. data.title: Embedded Staff Engineer
data.description: Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. About Priva Your Future Ecosystem Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s. What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide. Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably. With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong. Why this role matters At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability. As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance. This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform. Your role as Staff Engineer You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices. You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system. Your team You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology. What you’ll do Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks Contribute to software architecture and design decisions Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates Support application lifecycle management (ALM) Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) What you bring 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills Experience working in cross-functional and international teams Nice to have Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation What you get In numbers A competitive salary based on your experience; We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 8% holiday allowance; Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. For your own sustainability Be secured with our pension plan; Feel engaged and join our participation plan; Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. Our values Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves. Apply Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? Apply below or contact us for more information. We’ll get back to you within two weeks, we are keen to get to know you! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter
data.description: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future. For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required. At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions. As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization. Climate for growth Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water. Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve. How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies within your portfolio. You understand what the business needs, translate those needs into attractive and realistic candidate profiles and know how to reach the right talent. At the same time, you keep a sharp eye on recruitment quality, candidate experience and an efficient hiring process. You will: · Manage full-cycle recruitment for primarily non-technical and commercial positions; · Partner with hiring managers and leadership to define profiles, recruitment strategies and selection criteria; · Develop effective candidate sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter and AI-supported sourcing tools; · Proactively source and engage relevant talent in the market; · Help hiring managers create structured and effective interview and selection processes; · Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey; · Contribute to the further development of our employer branding and talent attraction activities; · Use recruitment insights and market knowledge to advise the business; · Identify opportunities to continuously improve our recruitment processes and ways of working. Who you are You are an experienced recruiter who combines strong people skills with a practical and business-oriented approach. data.title: Stage Eventmanagement
data.description: Stage Eventcoördinatie bij Priva Ben jij georganiseerd, ondernemend en krijg je energie van events? Vind je het leuk om dingen te regelen, overzicht te creëren en ervoor te zorgen dat alles achter de schermen klopt? Dan hebben we bij Priva een stageplek voor jou. Als Eventcoördinatie Stagiair(e) werk je direct samen met onze Event Manager aan het eventportfolio van Priva. Je bent dus niet alleen bezig met ondersteunende klusjes: je krijgt een actieve rol in de voorbereiding en uitvoering van verschillende events. Van de eerste planning tot de laatste materialen op de stand. Wat ga je doen? Samen met de Event Manager zorg je ervoor dat events soepel verlopen. Je houdt overzicht, pakt zelfstandig werkzaamheden op en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: Meewerken aan de voorbereiding en planning van events; Contact onderhouden met leveranciers en andere eventpartners; Ondersteunen bij registraties, uitnodigingen en deelnemerscommunicatie; Organiseren en beheren van eventmaterialen en promotiemiddelen; Planningen en draaiboeken voorbereiden en bijhouden; Offertes en praktische afspraken met leveranciers opvolgen; Helpen bij de logistieke voorbereiding van events; Meedenken over hoe we onze events slimmer en efficiënter kunnen organiseren; Tijdens eventdagen zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken en verantwoordelijkheden oppakken. Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar ervaart hoe een event daadwerkelijk tot leven komt. Je werkt samen met de Event Manager, leveranciers, collega's en andere betrokkenen en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens je stage werk je toe naar een van de grootste events binnen Priva: GreenTech Amsterdam in juni 2027. Een event waar veel bij komt kijken en waar je vanaf de voorbereiding tot en met de eventdagen bij betrokken bent. Van planning en leverancierscontact tot materialen, logistiek en de uitvoering op locatie: je ziet letterlijk het resultaat van jouw werk terug op de beursvloer. Na GreenTech 2027 zit jouw stage erop. Een mooie manier om je stageperiode af te sluiten én een event van formaat van dichtbij mee te maken. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen. Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen. Wat zoeken we in jou? We zoeken geen student die afwacht tot er een taak wordt gegeven. We zoeken iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren en het leuk vindt om het te regelen. Iemand die creatieve ideeen heeft en durft voorstellen te doen. Je: volgt een mbo-, hbo- of vergelijkbare opleiding richting Eventmanagement, Leisure & Events, Marketing, Communicatie of Hospitality; zoekt een meewerkstage en geen afstudeerstage; bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar; bent georganiseerd en houdt ervan om overzicht te creëren; Beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. vindt het leuk om met verschillende mensen en leveranciers te schakelen; bent praktisch ingesteld en denkt graag in oplossingen; durft vragen te stellen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig aan de slag; vindt het leuk als geen dag precies hetzelfde is; hebt interesse in zakelijke events, beurzen en marketing. Ervaring met events is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme, initiatief en organisatietalent vinden we belangrijker. Wat krijg je ervoor terug? Bij Priva krijg je geen stage waarin je vooral meekijkt. Je wordt onderdeel van het team en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt: een afwisselende meewerkstage met echte verantwoordelijkheid; directe begeleiding van een ervaren Event Manager; de kans om meerdere events van dichtbij mee te maken; ervaring met leveranciers, budgetten, planning en eventlogistiek; een kijkje achter de schermen bij zakelijke events en internationale beurzen; een stage waarin je kunt ontdekken waar jouw talenten liggen; én natuurlijk een hele mooie eindstreep: GreenTech 2027. Klaar om mee te organiseren? Ben jij de student die liever regelt dan toekijkt? Die energie krijgt van een goede planning, blij wordt als alles op zijn plek valt en het leuk vindt om samen naar een groot event toe te werken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Stuur ons je CV en vertel kort waarom jij enthousiast wordt van deze stage bij Priva. We kijken uit naar je reactie! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
data.description: At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. Your work will directly contribute to: Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) What You’ll Do Priva Digital Services & product engineering Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration Optimization & forecasting integration Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration Cloud infrastructure & DevOps Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring What you will NOT do This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective What We Offer You 💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price 🏦 Excellent pension contribution 🎓 €1,000 education budget per year ⏰ Flexible working hours, and location. 🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2) 🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer. 🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself 🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy 🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
